definition: （口語）詢問對方現在或某時段是否有空
example: Mia called and asked, 'Are you free for lunch tomorrow?'
example_translation: 米雅打電話來問：『你明天有空一起吃午餐嗎？』

definition: （口語）請對方慢慢來，不用趕
example: 'Take your time,' Ben said. 'The store doesn't close until six.'
example_translation: 班說：『慢慢來，店裡要到六點才關門。』

definition: 表示自己怕高或身處高處會害怕
example: At the rooftop bar, Leo admitted, 'I'm afraid of heights.'
example_translation: 在頂樓酒吧，里歐坦承：『我怕高。』

definition: （口語）出發或事情即將開始時說，常帶期待或無奈
example: 'Everyone ready?' 'Well, here we go,' Maya said as the doors opened.
example_translation: 『大家都準備好了嗎？』『好，要開始了。』門一開，瑪雅便說。

definition: 表示今天天氣很好，適合外出
example: Nina opened the curtains and said, 'It's a fine day for a picnic.'
example_translation: 妮娜拉開窗簾說：『今天天氣真好，適合去野餐。』

definition: （口語）問候對方近況如何
example: 'How's it going?' 'Pretty well—I just started a new job.'
example_translation: 『最近如何？』『挺好的，我剛開始一份新工作。』

definition: （口語）表示狀態好得不能再好
example: 'How are you feeling today?' 'Never better—I slept for ten hours.'
example_translation: 『你今天感覺怎麼樣？』『好得不得了，我睡了十個小時。』

definition: （口語）見面時表示很高興看到對方
example: At the reunion, Maya smiled and said, 'Good to see you again.'
example_translation: 在同學會上，瑪雅笑著說：『很高興又見到你。』

definition: （口語）招呼對方進門或進來
example: 'Come on in,' Sam said, holding the door open for us.
example_translation: 山姆替我們扶著門說：『快進來吧。』

definition: （禮貌口語）請對方坐下
example: The receptionist smiled and said, 'Have a seat; the doctor will be with you soon.'
example_translation: 接待員微笑著說：『請坐，醫師很快就來。』

definition: （口語）請對方自行取用食物或物品
example: At the buffet, our host said, 'Help yourself to anything on the table.'
example_translation: 在自助餐桌旁，主人說：『桌上的東西請隨意取用。』

definition: 詢問某個座位是否已有人使用
example: On the crowded train, I asked, 'Is this seat taken?'
example_translation: 在擁擠的火車上，我問：『這個位子有人坐嗎？』

definition: （口語）允許或鼓勵對方繼續做某事
example: 'May I open the window?' 'Go ahead; it's stuffy in here.'
example_translation: 『我可以開窗嗎？』『開吧，這裡很悶。』

definition: 表示某個座位已有人使用
example: 'Can I sit here?' 'Sorry, this seat is taken.'
example_translation: 『我可以坐這裡嗎？』『抱歉，這個位子有人了。』

definition: （隨意口語）請對方稍微挪動一下
example: 'Scoot over a bit so I can sit beside you,' Ava said.
example_translation: 艾娃說：『挪過去一點，讓我坐你旁邊。』

definition: （口語）詢問對方是否有一點時間
example: Jack tapped my shoulder and asked, 'Got a minute to talk?'
example_translation: 傑克拍了拍我的肩膀問：『有空聊一下嗎？』

definition: （口語）請對方看一下某物
example: 'Take a look at this photo,' Emma said. 'Isn't it beautiful?'
example_translation: 艾瑪說：『看看這張照片，是不是很美？』

definition: （口語）詢問是什麼事情造成延誤
example: The customers were waiting, so one asked, 'What's the holdup?'
example_translation: 顧客們等了很久，其中一人問：『到底在耽擱什麼？』

definition: 要對方穿好衣服，通常準備出門
example: 'Get dressed,' Dad called. 'We need to leave in ten minutes.'
example_translation: 爸爸喊道：『把衣服穿好，我們十分鐘後得出門。』

definition: （口語）表示自己快要遲到或已耽擱
example: 'I'm running late, so please start dinner without me,' Lia texted.
example_translation: 莉亞傳訊息說：『我來不及準時到，你們先吃晚餐，不用等我。』

definition: （口語）表示自己現在必須離開
example: When my bus pulled in, I told Noah, 'I gotta go—talk later.'
example_translation: 公車進站時，我告訴諾亞：『我得走了，晚點聊。』

definition: （口語）遞東西給對方時說在這裡
example: The barista handed me my tea and said, 'Here you are.'
example_translation: 咖啡師把茶遞給我，說：『您的茶來了。』

definition: （口語）表示同意某個提議或安排
example: 'Let's move the meeting to three.' 'Sounds good to me.'
example_translation: 『我們把會議改到三點吧。』『聽起來不錯。』

definition: 表示已準備妥當，可以出發或開始
example: 'Ready to go?' Dad asked after loading the last bag.
example_translation: 爸爸放好最後一個袋子後問：『準備好出發了嗎？』

definition: 請對方停下來等自己跟上
example: 'Wait for me!' Priya called as her friends crossed the bridge.
example_translation: 朋友們過橋時，普莉雅喊道：『等等我！』

definition: （口語）表示已準備好或狀況沒問題
example: 'Good to go,' the mechanic said after checking the brakes.
example_translation: 技師檢查煞車後說：『沒問題，可以上路了。』

definition: 表示自己已到場或讓人注意到自己
example: 'Here I am,' Luis called when he spotted us at the station.
example_translation: 路易斯在車站看到我們時喊道：『我在這裡。』

definition: 詢問某個東西或地方的名稱
example: Nora pointed to the kitchen tool and asked, 'What's it called?'
example_translation: 諾拉指著那件廚房工具問：『這叫什麼？』

definition: 催促對方採取行動處理問題
example: Water was pouring under the door, so Mei shouted, 'Do something!'
example_translation: 水正從門下湧進來，梅大喊：『快想想辦法！』

definition: （口語）表示再也受不了某事
example: The drilling started before dawn, and Jay said, 'I can't stand it anymore.'
example_translation: 鑽牆聲天沒亮就開始，傑說：『我再也受不了了。』

definition: （口語）表示一時忘了某件事
example: 'It slipped my mind,' I admitted when Jo asked about the file.
example_translation: 喬問起檔案時，我坦承：『我一時忘了。』

definition: （口語）安慰對方偶爾出錯很正常
example: After I spilled the soup, Ana smiled and said, 'It happens.'
example_translation: 我打翻湯後，安娜笑著說：『這種事難免會發生。』

definition: 沒聽清楚時請對方重複剛才的話
example: A train roared past, so I asked, 'What did you say?'
example_translation: 一列火車呼嘯而過，我便問：『你剛才說什麼？』

definition: 通話斷斷續續時告知對方訊號不穩
example: 'You're breaking up,' Dana said as I entered the elevator.
example_translation: 我走進電梯時，黛娜說：『你的聲音斷斷續續的。』

definition: 表示聽不見或聽不清對方說話
example: Over the factory noise, Ken shouted, 'I can't hear you.'
example_translation: 工廠噪音太大，肯喊道：『我聽不見你說話。』

definition: 請對方提高音量，語氣較直接
example: From the back row, Ella said, 'Speak up please; we can't hear.'
example_translation: 艾拉從後排說：『請大聲一點，我們聽不見。』

definition: （口語）詢問今天是星期幾
example: 'What day is today?' 'It's Friday—the concert is tonight.'
example_translation: 『今天星期幾？』『星期五，演唱會就在今晚。』

definition: 陳述今天是星期一
example: Owen checked the school calendar and said, 'Today is Monday.'
example_translation: 歐文看了學校行事曆後說：『今天是星期一。』

definition: （口語）道別並表示之後有機會再見
example: As we left the gym, Tessa waved and said, 'See you around.'
example_translation: 離開健身房時，泰莎揮手說：『改天見。』

definition: （口語）表示自己很快就會回來
example: 'Be right back,' the clerk said before checking the stockroom.
example_translation: 店員去倉庫查貨前說：『我馬上回來。』

definition: 詢問外面的天氣是否寒冷
example: Before school, Mia asked her brother, 'Is it cold outside?'
example_translation: 上學前，米雅問哥哥：『外面冷嗎？』

definition: （口語）表示外面有點冷
example: My roommate grabbed a coat and warned, 'It's chilly out.'
example_translation: 室友拿起外套提醒我：『外面有點涼。』

definition: （口語）打招呼或詢問發生什麼事
example: Ravi saw my worried face and asked, 'What's up?'
example_translation: 拉維看到我擔心的神情，便問：『怎麼了？』

definition: （口語）表示近況還不錯，沒什麼好抱怨
example: 'How's life?' my neighbor asked. 'Can't complain,' I replied.
example_translation: 鄰居問我近況如何，我回答：『還不錯，沒什麼好抱怨的。』

definition: （口語）表示自己的情況或感受也一樣
example: 'I'm exhausted after that hike.' 'Same here.'
example_translation: 『走完那段山路，我累壞了。』『我也是。』

definition: 說完看法後向對方確認是否正確
example: Omar asked the team, 'The deadline is Friday. Am I right?'
example_translation: 奧瑪問團隊：『截止日是星期五，我說得對吧？』

definition: （口語）表示事情完成或對方做對了
example: After Lily finally tied her shoelaces by herself, her dad smiled and said, 'There you go.'
example_translation: 莉莉終於自己綁好鞋帶，爸爸笑著說：『這樣就對了。』

definition: （口語）要大家注意聽接下來的話
example: The coach blew her whistle and said, 'Listen up, everyone.'
example_translation: 教練吹響哨子後說：『大家注意聽。』

definition: 請對方仔細考慮後再作決定
example: The manager offered me the role and said, 'Think it over tonight.'
example_translation: 經理提出職位邀請，並說：『今晚仔細考慮一下。』

definition: 表示決定由對方自行作主
example: Ben said, 'It's up to you—we can cook or order pizza.'
example_translation: 班說：『由你決定，我們可以煮飯或叫披薩。』

definition: 確認對方是否理解，語氣可能較嚴肅
example: After explaining the safety rule, the supervisor asked, 'Is that clear?'
example_translation: 主管說明安全規定後問：『都清楚了嗎？』

definition: 表示支持對方及其決定
example: Before my sister's audition, I told her, 'I'm behind you all the way.'
example_translation: 妹妹試鏡前，我告訴她：『我會全力支持你。』

definition: 表示到了該離開或出發的時候
example: Mom gathered our coats and announced, 'Time to go.'
example_translation: 媽媽收好我們的外套，宣布：『該走了。』

definition: 請對方跟自己一起前往某處
example: The nurse opened the door and said, 'Come with me, please.'
example_translation: 護理師打開門說：『請跟我來。』

definition: 關心或詢問對方是否已經吃過飯
example: Grandma called me after my shift and asked, 'Have you eaten?'
example_translation: 我下班後，奶奶打電話來問：『你吃過飯了嗎？』

definition: （口語）提議一起去喝杯咖啡
example: After the workshop, Zoe said, 'Let's grab coffee across the street.'
example_translation: 工作坊結束後，柔伊說：『我們去對街喝杯咖啡吧。』

definition: （口語）表示這次由自己請客付錢
example: 'My treat,' Carlos said on my birthday. 'Order dessert too.'
example_translation: 我生日那天，卡洛斯說：『這次我請客，甜點也點吧。』

definition: 在餐廳表示需要兩人座位
example: At the entrance, I told the host, 'Table for two, please.'
example_translation: 在餐廳入口，我告訴接待員：『麻煩安排兩人桌。』

definition: （口語）久別重逢時向對方打招呼
example: I ran into my former classmate and said, 'Long time no see!'
example_translation: 我巧遇以前的同學，便說：『好久不見！』

definition: （口語）結束談話並表示稍後再聊
example: My train arrived, so I ended the call with, 'Talk to you later.'
example_translation: 我的火車到了，於是我在電話中說：『晚點再聊。』

definition: 禮貌地為打擾對方先表示歉意
example: I knocked next door and said, 'Sorry to bother you, but may I borrow a ladder?'
example_translation: 我敲了鄰居的門說：『抱歉打擾了，可以借我梯子嗎？』

definition: 詢問對方是否正在排隊
example: At the bakery, I asked the woman ahead of me, 'Are you in line?'
example_translation: 在麵包店，我問前面的女士：『您有在排隊嗎？』

definition: （口語）強調同意對方剛才的說法
example: 'It's humid today.' 'It sure is—I started sweating outside.'
example_translation: 『今天很潮濕。』『真的，我在外面都流汗了。』

definition: （口語）表示沒事或不介意對方的過失
example: 'Sorry I spilled some water.' 'It's all good; I'll wipe it up.'
example_translation: 『抱歉，我灑了點水。』『沒事，我擦掉就好。』

definition: 在餐廳請服務人員拿帳單來
example: After dessert, Maya caught the server's eye and said, 'Check please.'
example_translation: 吃完甜點後，瑪雅示意服務生並說：『麻煩結帳。』

definition: 提議大家各自分攤餐費
example: When dinner ended, Amir suggested, 'Let's split the bill evenly.'
example_translation: 晚餐結束後，阿米爾提議：『我們平均分攤帳單吧。』

definition: 在餐廳請服務人員提供外帶盒
example: I had half my pasta left, so I asked, 'To go box please.'
example_translation: 我的義大利麵還剩一半，便說：『麻煩給我一個外帶盒。』

definition: （口語）表示不再需要協助或已準備好
example: The clerk offered another bag, but I said, 'I'm all set, thanks.'
example_translation: 店員問我是否還要袋子，我回答：『不用了，謝謝。』

definition: （隨意口語）道別並表示之後再見
example: At the office door, Devin waved and said, 'Catch you later.'
example_translation: 在辦公室門口，德文揮手說：『晚點見。』

definition: （口語）詢問原因，相當於為什麼
example: 'The pool is closed today.' 'How come?'
example_translation: 『游泳池今天沒開。』『為什麼？』

definition: 表示理解並認同對方的解釋
example: After the manager explained the change, I said, 'That makes sense.'
example_translation: 經理說明變動後，我說：『這樣就說得通了。』

definition: 表示自己正要離開或即將出發
example: 'I'm leaving now, so lock the door behind me,' Ava told her roommate.
example_translation: 艾娃告訴室友：『我現在要出門了，記得把門鎖上。』

definition: 確認約定時間後表示到時見
example: 'See you then,' I replied after confirming our ten o'clock appointment.
example_translation: 確認約在十點後，我回答：『到時見。』

definition: （口語）關心對方是否安好
example: After a player fell, the referee hurried over and asked, 'You okay?'
example_translation: 球員跌倒後，裁判趕過去問：『你還好嗎？』

definition: 表示發燒已退，體溫恢復正常
example: I texted Mom in the morning, 'My fever broke during the night.'
example_translation: 早上我傳訊息給媽媽：『我昨晚退燒了。』

definition: 用來祝身體不適的人早日好轉
example: I left soup at my coworker's desk and said, 'Feel better soon.'
example_translation: 我把湯放在同事桌上，並祝他早日康復。

definition: 祝生病或受傷的人早日康復
example: The class wrote 'Get well soon' on a card for their teacher.
example_translation: 全班在送給老師的卡片上寫著『祝您早日康復』。

definition: （口語）表示願意參加某項活動
example: 'We're cleaning the beach Saturday.' 'Count me in.'
example_translation: 『我們星期六要去淨灘。』『算我一份。』

definition: （口語）受幫助後表示欠對方一個人情
example: 'Thanks for covering my shift—I owe you one,' Nina said.
example_translation: 妮娜說：『謝謝你替我代班，我欠你一個人情。』

definition: 表示接受條件並達成約定
example: 'I'll sell you the bike for fifty.' 'It's a deal.'
example_translation: 『這輛腳踏車五十元賣你。』『成交。』

definition: 表示認為某件事不公平
example: When Leo got fewer chores, his sister protested, 'That's not fair.'
example_translation: 里歐分到較少家事時，妹妹抗議：『這不公平。』

definition: 演出或比賽前祝對方好運
example: Backstage, June hugged the actor and said, 'Break a leg tonight.'
example_translation: 在後台，瓊擁抱演員並祝他今晚演出順利。

definition: （口語）表示由對方作最後決定
example: 'Should we launch today or wait?' 'Your call,' the engineer replied.
example_translation: 『我們今天上線還是再等等？』『由你決定。』工程師回答。

definition: 確認對方是否聽到自己剛才的話
example: With the blender running, Dad asked, 'Did you hear me?'
example_translation: 果汁機運轉時，爸爸問：『你有聽到我說話嗎？』

definition: （口語）省略細節並直接說重點
example: 'Long story short, our canceled flight made us miss the wedding.'
example_translation: 『長話短說，班機取消害我們錯過了婚禮。』

definition: 較正式地表示願意代為協助
example: Seeing her heavy suitcase, the porter said, 'Allow me.'
example_translation: 行李員看到她沉重的行李箱，便說：『讓我來吧。』

definition: 在店裡詢問是否可以試穿某物
example: Holding up the jacket, I asked, 'Can I try it on?'
example_translation: 我拿起那件外套問：『我可以試穿嗎？』

definition: （口語）爽快答應對方的請求
example: 'Could we get two more napkins?' 'Sure thing,' the server replied.
example_translation: 『可以再給我們兩張餐巾嗎？』『當然可以。』服務生回答。

definition: 詢問衣物或物品的尺寸是否合適
example: Mom watched me lace the boots and asked, 'Does it fit?'
example_translation: 媽媽看我繫上靴子的鞋帶後問：『合腳嗎？』

definition: 表示衣物或物品的尺寸不合適
example: I stepped out of the fitting room and said, 'It doesn't fit around the shoulders.'
example_translation: 我走出試衣間說：『這件衣服的肩膀不合身。』

definition: 建議改試大一號的尺寸
example: The clerk saw the tight sleeves and suggested, 'Try a size up.'
example_translation: 店員看到袖子太緊，建議道：『試試大一號的。』

definition: （口語）表達不耐煩或請對方別再為難
example: When my friend teased me again, I laughed and said, 'Give me a break.'
example_translation: 朋友又取笑我時，我笑著說：『饒了我吧。』

definition: 表示自己也不做或不喜歡前述的事
example: 'I don't enjoy horror movies.' 'Neither do I.'
example_translation: 『我不喜歡恐怖片。』『我也不喜歡。』

definition: 購物時表示決定要買眼前的商品
example: After comparing the two mugs, I said, 'I'll take this one.'
example_translation: 比較兩個馬克杯後，我說：『我要買這個。』

definition: 結帳時詢問顧客要用現金或刷卡
example: The cashier scanned my groceries and asked, 'Cash or card?'
example_translation: 收銀員掃完我的食品後問：『付現還是刷卡？』

definition: 表示自己會用現金付款
example: At the pharmacy counter, I said, 'I'll pay in cash.'
example_translation: 在藥局櫃檯，我說：『我要付現。』

definition: 請對方把事情完成並儘快結束
example: The host signaled to the speaker, 'Please wrap it up in two minutes.'
example_translation: 主持人示意講者：『請在兩分鐘內結束。』

definition: 表示自己需要購物或付款收據
example: Before leaving the hotel, I said, 'I need a receipt for my expense report.'
example_translation: 離開飯店前，我說：『我的費用報告需要收據。』

definition: 向店家詢問是否可以退回商品
example: At the electronics counter, Lee asked, 'Can I return this if it doesn't work?'
example_translation: 在電子產品櫃檯，李問：『如果不能用，我可以退貨嗎？』

definition: （口語）稱讚對方做得很好
example: After Eva scored her first goal, her coach shouted, 'Way to go!'
example_translation: 伊娃踢進第一球後，教練喊道：『太棒了！』

definition: 表示看來快要下雨，提醒對方留意
example: Mom looked at the dark clouds and said, 'It's going to rain—take an umbrella.'
example_translation: 媽媽看著烏雲說：『快下雨了，帶把傘吧。』

definition: （口語）詢問接下來的安排或做法
example: When everyone arrived at the campsite, Kai asked, 'What's the plan for dinner?'
example_translation: 大家抵達營地後，凱問：『晚餐怎麼安排？』

definition: （口語）表示有一點或不完全如此
example: 'Are you nervous about the interview?' 'Sort of, but I'm mostly excited.'
example_translation: 『你對面試感到緊張嗎？』『有一點，但我主要是興奮。』

definition: 表示同意對方，或會支持陪伴對方
example: During the budget meeting, Rosa nodded and said, 'I'm with you on this.'
example_translation: 預算會議中，蘿莎點頭說：『這件事我支持你。』

definition: （口語）表示關鍵時刻或所找的事物到了
example: At the final audition, Lena took a breath and thought, 'This is it.'
example_translation: 最後試鏡時，莉娜深吸一口氣，心想：『就是現在了。』

definition: 表示自己非常興奮或欣喜
example: When the gallery accepted her painting, June said, 'I'm thrilled beyond words.'
example_translation: 畫廊接受她的畫作後，君說：『我高興得難以言喻。』

definition: （口語）剛談到某人時，那人正好出現
example: 'Speak of the devil—there's Omar now,' Mia said as he entered the café.
example_translation: 奧瑪走進咖啡館時，米雅說：『說曹操，曹操到。』

definition: 通話或訊息中詢問對方身分
example: I answered the unfamiliar number and asked, 'Who is this?'
example_translation: 我接起陌生號碼的來電，問道：『請問你是誰？』

definition: 催促對方作出決定，不要再猶豫
example: The line was growing, so Nina said, 'Make up your mind and choose a flavor.'
example_translation: 隊伍越排越長，妮娜說：『快決定要哪個口味吧。』

definition: 表示會照對方的意願行事
example: The tailor nodded and said, 'As you wish; I'll shorten the sleeves.'
example_translation: 裁縫點頭說：『就照您的意思，我會把袖子改短。』

definition: 鼓勵對方嘗試看看某事
example: 'The climbing wall looks hard.' 'Give it a try—I'll spot you.'
example_translation: 『那面攀岩牆看起來很難。』『試試看，我會在下面保護你。』

definition: 詢問某件剛完成的事結果如何
example: After Leo's driving test, his sister called and asked, 'How did it go?'
example_translation: 里歐考完駕照後，姊姊打電話問：『結果怎麼樣？』

definition: 表示身體某處非常疼痛
example: At the clinic, Ava held her wrist and said, 'It really hurts when I move it.'
example_translation: 在診所裡，艾娃按著手腕說：『我一動它就真的很痛。』

definition: （誇張口語）表示疼痛或困擾讓人很難受
example: Dan loosened his new shoes and groaned, 'It's killing me right here.'
example_translation: 丹鬆開新鞋，呻吟道：『這裡痛死我了。』

definition: （口語）非常感謝對方的幫助
example: When Priya returned my lost keys, I said, 'Thanks a million—you saved my day.'
example_translation: 普莉雅歸還我遺失的鑰匙時，我說：『太感謝了，你救了我一天。』

definition: 表示彼此不再相欠或比分相同
example: After I paid for lunch, Noah smiled and said, 'We are even now.'
example_translation: 我付完午餐錢後，諾亞笑著說：『我們現在互不相欠了。』

definition: （口語）強烈否定，表示事實恰恰相反
example: 'Was the hike easy?' 'Far from it—we climbed for six hours.'
example_translation: 『那趟健行輕鬆嗎？』『一點也不，我們爬了六小時。』

definition: 表示勉強順從，也可能帶不以為然語氣
example: Tired of arguing about the route, Ben sighed, 'Whatever you say.'
example_translation: 班不想再爭論路線，嘆氣說：『隨你怎麼說。』

definition: 表示得知原因後覺得結果不足為奇
example: 'The heater is broken.' 'No wonder the office feels so cold.'
example_translation: 『暖氣壞了。』『難怪辦公室這麼冷。』

definition: （口語）確認對方是否當真，常帶驚訝
example: When Jo offered me the concert ticket, I asked, 'Are you serious?'
example_translation: 喬說要把演唱會門票給我時，我問：『你是認真的嗎？』

definition: 強烈而明確地拒絕或否定
example: 'Can I drive without a license?' 'Absolutely not,' Dad replied.
example_translation: 『我可以沒有駕照就開車嗎？』『絕對不行。』爸爸回答。

definition: 避免誤解，用來澄清接下來的看法
example: 'Don't get me wrong—I like the design, but the chair is uncomfortable.'
example_translation: 『別誤會，我喜歡這個設計，只是椅子坐起來不舒服。』

definition: 淡化自己的付出或安慰對方事情不嚴重
example: 'Thank you for carrying the boxes.' 'It's nothing; I was glad to help.'
example_translation: 『謝謝你搬這些箱子。』『小事而已，我很樂意幫忙。』

definition: 提醒對方注意顯而易見的情況，語氣較急
example: Maya pointed at the smoke and cried, 'Don't you see? We need to leave.'
example_translation: 瑪雅指著濃煙喊道：『你沒看見嗎？我們得離開。』

definition: （口語）表示已理解意思或做法
example: After one more demonstration, Eli nodded and said, 'I get it now.'
example_translation: 又示範一次後，伊萊點頭說：『我現在懂了。』

definition: 詢問對方是否已準備好
example: The photographer raised the camera and asked, 'Are you ready?'
example_translation: 攝影師舉起相機問：『你準備好了嗎？』

definition: 表示某事越早完成越好
example: 'When should I send the contract?' 'The sooner the better.'
example_translation: 『我什麼時候寄合約？』『越快越好。』

definition: 詢問是否能及時到達或成功完成
example: Seeing the airport traffic, Luis asked, 'Can we make it before boarding closes?'
example_translation: 看到前往機場的車潮，路易斯問：『我們能在登機截止前趕到嗎？』

definition: 要求對方別催促，讓自己按步調完成
example: While choosing a gift, Hana told her brother, 'Don't rush me—I need a minute.'
example_translation: 挑禮物時，花奈對哥哥說：『別催我，我需要一點時間。』

definition: 表示可用時間已經用完
example: The moderator checked the clock and said, 'We're out of time, so let's stop here.'
example_translation: 主持人看了時鐘說：『我們沒時間了，就到這裡吧。』

definition: 表示自己沒有兄弟姊妹
example: When classmates asked about siblings, Erin said, 'I'm an only child.'
example_translation: 同學問起兄弟姊妹時，艾琳說：『我是獨生女。』

definition: （口語）確認事情是否真的，或強調確實如此
example: 'You won front-row tickets?' 'For real—look at the email.'
example_translation: 『你抽到第一排的票？』『真的，你看這封郵件。』

definition: （口語）說明剛才只是開玩笑，請別當真
example: When Sam looked worried, I laughed and said, 'Just joking—we aren't moving.'
example_translation: 山姆露出擔心的表情時，我笑說：『開玩笑的，我們沒有要搬家。』

definition: 提醒對方記住某項重要資訊
example: 'Keep that in mind: the last bus leaves at five,' the guide told us.
example_translation: 導遊告訴我們：『請記住，末班車五點開。』

definition: 表示自己知道的資訊僅止於此
example: After describing the missing package, the clerk said, 'That's all I know.'
example_translation: 店員說明包裹失蹤的情況後表示：『我知道的就這些。』

definition: 請對方留在身邊，也可鼓勵其保持清醒
example: The paramedic held his hand and said, 'Stay with me; help is here.'
example_translation: 救護員握著他的手說：『撐著點，救援到了。』

definition: （口語）表示手機沒電或無法使用
example: At the station, Ruby said, 'My phone's dead, so I can't show the ticket.'
example_translation: 在車站裡，露比說：『我的手機沒電了，沒辦法出示車票。』

definition: 提醒或要求對方替手機充電
example: Before the storm, Dad said, 'Charge your phone in case the power goes out.'
example_translation: 暴風雨來臨前，爸爸說：『先把手機充好電，以防停電。』

definition: （口語）可表驚訝，也可反諷事情顯而易見
example: 'The puppy chewed another shoe.' 'You don't say,' Mia replied dryly.
example_translation: 『小狗又咬壞一隻鞋。』『是喔，真看不出來。』米雅冷冷地回道。

definition: 店員詢問餐點內用還是外帶
example: At the sandwich counter, the cashier asked, 'For here or to go?'
example_translation: 在三明治櫃檯，店員問：『內用還是外帶？』

definition: 用餐開始前祝對方用餐愉快
example: The server set down the pasta and said, 'Enjoy your meal.'
example_translation: 服務生放下義大利麵，說：『請慢用。』

definition: （口語）表示某個安排自己可以接受
example: 'Let's meet by the library at noon.' 'Works for me.'
example_translation: 『我們中午在圖書館旁碰面。』『我可以。』

definition: 表示事情複雜，無法三言兩語說完
example: When coworkers asked about the broken trophy, I sighed, 'It's a long story.'
example_translation: 同事問起破掉的獎盃時，我嘆氣說：『說來話長。』

definition: 承認對方的說法或判斷正確
example: After checking the receipt, the cashier said, 'You're right; I charged you twice.'
example_translation: 收銀員核對收據後說：『你說得對，我重複收費了。』

definition: 詢問現在的時間
example: My hands were covered in flour, so I asked, 'What time is it?'
example_translation: 我雙手沾滿麵粉，只好問：『現在幾點？』

definition: 表示某事遲早會發生
example: 'Sooner or later, the chords will feel natural, so keep practicing.'
example_translation: 『遲早這些和弦會變得順手，所以繼續練習吧。』

definition: 表示某物無法運作或某方法無效
example: I pressed the printer button twice and said, 'It doesn't work.'
example_translation: 我按了兩次印表機按鈕，說：『它不能用。』

definition: 表示不必麻煩，也可能勸對方別白費力氣
example: 'Should I pick you up?' 'Don't bother; the bus stops outside my house.'
example_translation: 『要我去接你嗎？』『不用麻煩，公車就停在我家門外。』

definition: 表示某事早該發生，常帶不耐或欣慰
example: When the delayed train arrived, a passenger said, 'It's about time.'
example_translation: 誤點的火車終於抵達時，一名乘客說：『早該來了。』

definition: （口語）表示自己準備離開
example: As the party quieted down, Theo said, 'I'm going to go; it's getting late.'
example_translation: 派對漸漸安靜後，西奧說：『我要走了，時間不早了。』

definition: 詢問為何如此匆忙，常用來勸人放慢
example: When Eva started packing before dessert, I asked, 'What's the rush?'
example_translation: 伊娃甜點還沒吃就開始收拾時，我問：『幹嘛這麼急？』

definition: （口語）承認自己犯了錯或把事情搞砸
example: After emailing the wrong client, Mark admitted, 'I messed up.'
example_translation: 馬克把郵件寄錯客戶後坦承：『我搞砸了。』

definition: 表示後果是對方自找的，語氣可能責備
example: When Leo complained about the extra-hot sauce, Ana said, 'You asked for it.'
example_translation: 里歐抱怨醬料太辣時，安娜說：『這是你自己要求的。』

definition: （口語）表示自己接受某個決定或安排
example: 'We can take the early train instead.' 'Fine with me.'
example_translation: 『我們可以改搭早班火車。』『我沒意見。』

definition: 表示剛才的話並非真心或不是故意的
example: After her harsh remark, Zoe apologized, 'I didn't mean it; I was upset.'
example_translation: 柔伊說了重話後道歉：『我不是那個意思，我當時很難過。』

definition: 表示因自己的錯誤而生自己的氣
example: After forgetting the tickets, Ian said, 'I'm mad at myself for being careless.'
example_translation: 伊恩忘了帶票，說：『我氣自己太粗心。』

definition: （口語）請對方幫忙做某件事
example: While moving the sofa, Kim called, 'Give me a hand with this end.'
example_translation: 搬沙發時，金喊道：『來幫我抬這一端。』

definition: 禮貌表示自己無法答應或做到
example: When asked to work Sunday, Nia replied, 'I'm afraid I can't; I'll be away.'
example_translation: 被問到週日能否上班時，妮雅回答：『恐怕不行，我不在城裡。』

definition: （口語）表示會替對方介紹合適的約會對象
example: When I mentioned being single, Ava laughed and said, 'I'll fix you up with my cousin.'
example_translation: 我提到自己單身時，艾娃笑說：『我來介紹你認識我表親。』

definition: 私下提醒對方褲子拉鍊沒拉
example: At the photo booth, my friend whispered, 'Your fly is down.'
example_translation: 在拍照亭旁，朋友小聲提醒我：『你的褲子拉鍊沒拉。』

definition: （口語）表示會去查看、了解或試試某事物
example: When Jo recommended the new bakery, I said, 'I'll check it out this weekend.'
example_translation: 喬推薦新麵包店時，我說：『我這週末會去看看。』

definition: 表示自己睡得很好、休息充分
example: At breakfast, Gran smiled and said, 'I slept well for the first time all week.'
example_translation: 早餐時，奶奶笑著說：『這是我整週第一次睡得好。』

definition: 稱讚對方英語說得流利或清楚
example: After the presentation, Mei told Pavel, 'You speak English well.'
example_translation: 簡報結束後，梅對帕維爾說：『你的英語說得很好。』

definition: 表示所需的東西已足夠，不需要更多
example: The clerk handed me one form, and I said, 'That's all I need, thanks.'
example_translation: 店員遞給我一張表格，我說：『我只需要這個，謝謝。』

definition: 強調某事自己非做不可
example: Though the apology felt difficult, Sara said, 'I must do it before I lose her trust.'
example_translation: 儘管道歉很難，莎拉仍說：『我必須在失去她的信任前去做。』

definition: 嚴厲警告對方別企圖做某事
example: When Max reached for the hidden cake, his sister warned, 'Don't even try it.'
example_translation: 麥克斯伸手想拿藏起來的蛋糕時，姊姊警告：『想都別想。』

definition: 詢問對方話語的意思，也可表示不解
example: When the doctor mentioned another test, I asked, 'What do you mean?'
example_translation: 醫師提到還要檢查時，我問：『你的意思是什麼？』

definition: 表示會親自確保某事得到處理
example: The supervisor heard about the leak and said, 'I'll see to it right away.'
example_translation: 主管聽說漏水後表示：『我會立刻處理。』

definition: 表示某事令人難以置信或非常出色
example: Watching the northern lights, Bea whispered, 'It's incredible.'
example_translation: 看著北極光，碧雅低聲說：『真是太不可思議了。』

definition: 受稱讚或邀請時表示感到受寵若驚
example: When they asked me to lead the ceremony, I said, 'I'm flattered.'
example_translation: 他們邀請我主持典禮時，我說：『我真是受寵若驚。』

definition: 把相同問題轉問對方，詢問其情況或看法
example: 'I prefer tea. What about you?' Lina asked her new roommate.
example_translation: 莉娜問新室友：『我比較喜歡茶，你呢？』

definition: （口語）表示截至目前一切順利
example: 'How's the renovation going?' 'So far so good—we're on schedule.'
example_translation: 『翻修進行得如何？』『目前一切順利，進度也正常。』

definition: 詢問對方是否醒著或仍清醒
example: Hearing thunder at midnight, Finn whispered, 'Are you awake?'
example_translation: 半夜聽見雷聲，芬恩小聲問：『你醒著嗎？』

definition: 表示對方終於起床，可能帶打趣或不耐
example: When Noah entered the kitchen at noon, Mum laughed, 'You finally got up.'
example_translation: 諾亞中午走進廚房時，媽媽笑說：『你終於起床了。』

definition: （口語）表示自己正要出門或離開
example: Putting on her coat, Dana called, 'I'm heading out—do you need anything?'
example_translation: 黛娜穿上外套喊道：『我要出門了，你需要什麼嗎？』

definition: （口語）表示雨下得非常大
example: Ravi looked through the shop window and said, 'It's pouring outside.'
example_translation: 拉維從店面窗戶往外看，說：『外面正下著傾盆大雨。』

definition: 要求對方上車，語氣直接
example: As hail began to fall, Dad shouted, 'Get in the car now.'
example_translation: 冰雹開始落下時，爸爸喊道：『快上車。』

definition: 提醒或要求對方繫好安全帶
example: Before leaving the driveway, Aunt May said, 'Buckle up, everyone.'
example_translation: 車子駛離車道前，梅阿姨說：『大家繫好安全帶。』

definition: 勸對方別太挑剔，常用於食物或選擇
example: At dinner, Dad said, 'Don't be picky; try one bite of the beans.'
example_translation: 晚餐時，爸爸說：『別挑食，豆子至少吃一口。』

definition: 要求對方把自己的食物吃完
example: Before dessert, Mum reminded us, 'Finish your food first.'
example_translation: 上甜點前，媽媽提醒我們：『先把飯吃完。』

definition: 表示自己接到一通電話
example: During lunch, Rosa said, 'I got a call from the clinic about my results.'
example_translation: 午餐時，蘿莎說：『我接到診所打來談檢查結果的電話。』

definition: 詢問剛才是哪個人打電話給對方
example: When Eli returned to the table, his partner asked, 'Who called you?'
example_translation: 伊萊回到桌旁時，伴侶問：『剛才誰打給你？』

definition: 在店裡詢問某件商品的價格
example: Holding up a scarf at the market, June asked, 'How much is this?'
example_translation: 君在市場拿起一條圍巾問：『這個多少錢？』

definition: （簡短口語）詢問商品是否可以打折
example: Buying two lamps, Omar asked the seller, 'Any discount if I take both?'
example_translation: 奧瑪買兩盞燈時問賣家：『兩個都買有折扣嗎？』

definition: （簡短口語）表示價格高得難以接受
example: After seeing the hotel rate, Kim shook her head: 'Too expensive for one night.'
example_translation: 金看到旅館房價後搖頭說：『住一晚太貴了。』

definition: （口語）表示價格划算或協議令人滿意
example: When the seller included free delivery, I said, 'Good deal—I'll take it.'
example_translation: 賣家答應免費配送時，我說：『很划算，我買了。』

definition: 詢問對方是否還需要其他東西或服務
example: After packing the medicine, the pharmacist asked, 'Anything else today?'
example_translation: 藥師裝好藥後問：『今天還需要別的嗎？』

definition: 表示事情到此為止，或自己不再需要其他東西
example: At the bakery, I paid for two rolls and said, 'That's all, thank you.'
example_translation: 在麵包店裡，我買了兩個餐包後說：『就這些，謝謝。』

definition: 在店裡表示只是看看，目前不需要協助
example: When the clerk offered help, Nia smiled and said, 'Just looking, thanks.'
example_translation: 店員上前協助時，妮雅笑說：『我只是看看，謝謝。』

definition: 表示某事留待下次，或提醒下次要改進
example: When the café was full, Leo said, 'Next time, let's reserve a table.'
example_translation: 咖啡館客滿時，里歐說：『下次我們先訂位吧。』

definition: 表示店家只收現金，不接受其他付款方式
example: The market vendor pointed to a sign and said, 'Cash only, please.'
example_translation: 市場攤販指著告示說：『只收現金。』

definition: 付款時表示零錢不用找回
example: I handed the driver a ten and said, 'Keep the change.'
example_translation: 我遞給司機十元，說：『零錢不用找了。』

definition: 詢問自己是否可以離開
example: After answering the officer's questions, Priya asked, 'Am I free to go?'
example_translation: 回答完警員的問題後，普莉雅問：『我可以走了嗎？』

definition: （口語）沒聽清楚時請對方再說一次
example: The announcement was muffled, so Jo leaned closer and asked, 'Say again?'
example_translation: 廣播聲含糊不清，喬靠近問：『可以再說一次嗎？』

definition: 要求對方直接說重點，不要繞圈子
example: After ten minutes of excuses, the manager said, 'Come to the point.'
example_translation: 聽了十分鐘的藉口後，經理說：『直接說重點。』

definition: 鼓勵對方即使困難也不要放棄
example: Before the final lap, my coach called, 'Never give up—keep moving.'
example_translation: 最後一圈前，教練喊道：『永遠別放棄，繼續跑。』

definition: （口語）鼓勵對方有能力把事情做好
example: As Mina stepped onto the stage, her friend whispered, 'You got this.'
example_translation: 米娜走上舞台時，朋友低聲說：『你一定行。』

definition: （口語）表示為對方的表現感到驕傲
example: After my son finished his first race, I hugged him and said, 'Proud of you.'
example_translation: 兒子完成第一次比賽後，我抱著他說：『我以你為榮。』

definition: 表示替對方高興，也可能依語氣帶反諷
example: 'I finally passed my exam.' 'Good for you—you worked hard.'
example_translation: 『我終於通過考試了。』『真替你高興，你很努力。』

definition: （口語）表示自己要離開了
example: At the end of my shift, I waved and said, 'I'm off—see you tomorrow.'
example_translation: 下班時，我揮手說：『我要走了，明天見。』

definition: 表示會陪對方走到門口或外面送行
example: When the meeting ended, Ms. Chen said, 'I'll walk you out to the lobby.'
example_translation: 會議結束時，陳女士說：『我陪你走到大廳。』

definition: 睡前祝對方安穩好眠
example: Dad tucked in the twins and whispered, 'Sleep tight, both of you.'
example_translation: 爸爸替雙胞胎蓋好被子，輕聲說：『你們倆好好睡。』

definition: 道別時提醒對方小心駕駛
example: As the guests left in the rain, our host called, 'Drive safely.'
example_translation: 客人在雨中離開時，主人喊道：『開車小心。』

definition: 表示快到目的地或快完成了
example: Halfway up the last hill, our guide said, 'Almost there—just five more minutes.'
example_translation: 爬到最後一座山丘途中，嚮導說：『快到了，再五分鐘。』

definition: 表示自己覺得體重增加或身材變胖
example: After his trousers felt tight, Ben frowned and said, 'I'm getting fat.'
example_translation: 班發現褲子變緊後皺眉說：『我正在變胖。』

definition: 表示自己正在控制飲食以減重或保健
example: When cake was offered, Pia said, 'I'm on a diet, so I'll have some fruit.'
example_translation: 有人端上蛋糕時，皮雅說：『我在控制飲食，所以吃點水果就好。』

definition: （口語）表示對某事已厭煩到受不了
example: After another noisy night, Lou said, 'I'm sick of it—I'm calling the landlord.'
example_translation: 又經歷吵鬧的一夜後，盧說：『我受夠了，我要打給房東。』

definition: 表示不愉快的事已經結束，常用來安慰
example: After the storm passed, Mum hugged us and said, 'It's over now.'
example_translation: 暴風雨過去後，媽媽抱著我們說：『現在都結束了。』

definition: 真誠感謝對方所做的事
example: When my colleague covered my shift, I said, 'I appreciate it, truly.'
example_translation: 同事替我代班時，我說：『我真的很感謝。』

definition: 禮貌回應感謝，表示很樂意幫忙
example: 'Thank you for showing us around.' 'My pleasure,' the curator replied.
example_translation: 『謝謝您帶我們參觀。』『這是我的榮幸。』館員回答。

definition: 詢問某件事是誰做的
example: Seeing paint on the kitchen floor, Dad asked, 'Who did it?'
example_translation: 爸爸看到廚房地板上的顏料後問：『這是誰弄的？』

definition: 表示目前沒有人知道答案或真相
example: 'Why did the power fail?' 'No one knows yet,' the technician said.
example_translation: 『為什麼停電？』『目前沒有人知道。』技師說。

definition: 詢問某件東西是否屬於對方
example: I found a blue umbrella by the desk and asked Mia, 'Is it yours?'
example_translation: 我在桌旁找到一把藍傘，便問米雅：『這是你的嗎？』

definition: 詢問消息來源，常帶驚訝或懷疑
example: When Ana mentioned my secret trip, I asked, 'Who told you that?'
example_translation: 安娜提到我的祕密旅行時，我問：『那是誰告訴你的？』

definition: （口語）表示睡過頭或比平常晚起床
example: Rushing into the office, Jay apologized, 'I slept in and missed the bus.'
example_translation: 傑匆忙進辦公室後道歉：『我睡過頭，還錯過了公車。』

definition: 表示沒聽到鬧鐘，因此未準時起床
example: When the coach asked why I was late, I said, 'I missed my alarm.'
example_translation: 教練問我為何遲到時，我說：『我沒聽到鬧鐘。』

definition: 表示對方臉色蒼白，通常帶關心
example: At rehearsal, Nina touched my arm and said, 'You look pale—sit down.'
example_translation: 彩排時，妮娜碰了碰我的手臂說：『你臉色很白，坐下吧。』

definition: 關心對方是否安好或有沒有受傷
example: After the cyclist fell, a passerby ran over and asked, 'Are you all right?'
example_translation: 腳踏車騎士摔倒後，路人跑過去問：『你還好嗎？』

definition: 表示身體不舒服或心情不佳
example: During class, Ella told the teacher, 'I don't feel good; may I see the nurse?'
example_translation: 上課時，艾拉告訴老師：『我不舒服，可以去找護理師嗎？』

definition: 表示自己感到頭暈或失去平衡感
example: After standing up too quickly, Rob held the table and said, 'I'm dizzy.'
example_translation: 羅布起身太快，扶著桌子說：『我頭暈。』

definition: 安撫或提醒對方保持冷靜
example: When the elevator stopped, Lena said, 'Stay calm; the emergency light is on.'
example_translation: 電梯停住時，莉娜說：『保持冷靜，緊急照明還亮著。』

definition: 身體不適時詢問是否可以躺下休息
example: At the nurse's office, Tom asked, 'Can I lie down for a few minutes?'
example_translation: 在保健室裡，湯姆問：『我可以躺幾分鐘嗎？』

definition: 表示自己感到噁心、想吐
example: On the rocking ferry, Sue closed her eyes and said, 'I feel nauseous.'
example_translation: 渡輪搖晃時，蘇閉上眼睛說：『我覺得很想吐。』

definition: 表示自己狀況沒問題，也可能婉拒關心
example: After a short rest, Amir stood up and said, 'I'm fine now.'
example_translation: 短暫休息後，阿米爾站起來說：『我現在沒事了。』

definition: （口語）表示不用擔心，或回應道歉與感謝
example: 'Sorry I returned the book late.' 'No worries; I hadn't needed it.'
example_translation: 『抱歉這本書還晚了。』『別在意，我之前也沒用到。』

definition: 詢問對方對自己外表或穿著的看法
example: Before the ceremony, Rosa adjusted her hat and asked, 'How do I look?'
example_translation: 典禮前，蘿莎調整帽子後問：『我看起來怎麼樣？』

definition: 稱讚對方穿著俐落又有精神
example: When Dev arrived in his new suit, his sister said, 'You look sharp.'
example_translation: 戴夫穿著新西裝到場時，姊姊說：『你看起來真俐落。』

definition: 表示商品正在特價出售
example: 'On sale until Sunday,' the clerk said, pointing to the boots.
example_translation: 店員指著靴子說：『特價到星期日。』

definition: 表示自己的財力不足以購買或承擔某事
example: After checking the rent, Mina said, 'I can't afford it on my salary.'
example_translation: 米娜查看租金後說：『以我的薪水負擔不起。』

definition: 表示明白對方所說，也可表示正在理解
example: After the mechanic explained the noise, I nodded and said, 'I see.'
example_translation: 技師解釋異音的原因後，我點頭說：『我明白了。』

definition: （口語）表示自己已經出發、正在前往
example: When Jo texted from the café, I replied, 'I'm on my way—ten minutes.'
example_translation: 喬從咖啡館傳訊息來時，我回覆：『我在路上了，十分鐘到。』

definition: 請對方提早到達
example: The organizer told all volunteers, 'Come early so we can assign the booths.'
example_translation: 主辦人告訴志工：『請提早來，好讓我們分配攤位。』

definition: 表示自己很快就會抵達
example: I called the babysitter from the bus and said, 'I'll be there soon.'
example_translation: 我在公車上打給保母說：『我很快就到。』

definition: 鄭重承諾對方可以相信自己
example: 'You have my word: the roof will be done Friday,' the contractor said.
example_translation: 承包商說：『我向你保證，屋頂週五會完工。』

definition: 表示自己已經回到原處
example: After picking up the parcel, Dad opened the door and called, 'I'm back.'
example_translation: 爸爸領完包裹後打開門喊道：『我回來了。』

definition: 鼓勵對方目前表現很好，繼續下去
example: During her first skating lesson, the coach said, 'You're doing great—keep going.'
example_translation: 第一次溜冰課上，教練說：『你做得很好，繼續下去。』

definition: 禮讓女性先行，帶傳統禮貌語氣
example: At the elevator, Marco held the door and said, 'Ladies first.'
example_translation: 在電梯口，馬可扶著門說：『女士優先。』

definition: 禮貌請對方先走或先做
example: We reached the narrow doorway together, so I stepped aside and said, 'After you.'
example_translation: 我們同時走到狹窄門口，我便側身說：『您先請。』

definition: （口語）打招呼並詢問對方最近的新消息
example: Over coffee, Tia smiled at her old classmate and asked, 'What's new?'
example_translation: 喝咖啡時，蒂雅笑著問老同學：『最近有什麼新鮮事？』

definition: 表示情況和平常一樣，沒有特別變化
example: 'How busy is the shop today?' 'Same as usual,' Ken replied.
example_translation: 『今天店裡忙嗎？』『跟平常一樣。』肯回答。

definition: 要求對方關掉電器、裝置或聲音
example: The baby had fallen asleep, so Mum whispered, 'Turn it off.'
example_translation: 寶寶睡著後，媽媽小聲說：『把它關掉。』

definition: 強調自己說的是真心話，不是在開玩笑
example: When Noor offered her spare room, she added, 'I mean it—stay as long as you need.'
example_translation: 努爾提出讓我住空房後補充：『我是認真的，你需要住多久都行。』

definition: 表示支持對方、與對方立場一致
example: Before the hearing, my colleague assured me, 'I'm on your side.'
example_translation: 聽證會前，同事向我保證：『我是站在你這邊的。』

definition: 表示某方法雖不保證成功，但值得嘗試
example: 'The stain may come out with vinegar.' 'It's worth a try.'
example_translation: 『用醋也許能去掉污漬。』『值得一試。』

definition: 指出對方的話或行動無助於改善情況
example: While I searched for the keys, Pat kept joking, so I said, 'That's not helping.'
example_translation: 我找鑰匙時，派特一直開玩笑，我便說：『這樣一點幫助也沒有。』

definition: 明確表示自己拒絕做某件事
example: When asked to hide the safety report, Lee said, 'I won't do it.'
example_translation: 有人要李隱瞞安全報告時，他說：『我不會這麼做。』

definition: （口語）表示要根據線索猜測接下來的內容
example: Seeing flour on Ana's shirt, I smiled and said, 'Let me guess—you baked cookies.'
example_translation: 看到安娜衣服上的麵粉，我笑說：『讓我猜，你烤了餅乾。』

definition: 請對方打電話聯絡自己
example: The landlord said, 'Give me a call if the heater stops again.'
example_translation: 房東說：『暖氣若又停了，就打電話給我。』

definition: 中斷後詢問剛才談到或做到哪裡
example: After the fire drill, the teacher reopened her notes and asked, 'Where were we?'
example_translation: 消防演習後，老師重新打開筆記問：『我們剛才講到哪裡？』

definition: 表示自己剛剛睡醒
example: When my sister called at dawn, I yawned and said, 'I just woke up.'
example_translation: 姊姊清晨打來時，我打著哈欠說：『我剛睡醒。』

definition: 表示對方可能永遠不會知道，也可鼓勵嘗試
example: 'You'll never know unless you try, so apply for the scholarship.'
example_translation: 『不試試看你永遠不會知道，所以去申請獎學金吧。』

definition: 表示會去開門或替人扶門
example: When the bell rang during dinner, Sam stood and said, 'I'll get the door.'
example_translation: 晚餐時門鈴響起，山姆站起來說：『我去開門。』

definition: 以天氣為話題寒暄並尋求認同
example: Waiting at the bus stop, an elderly man smiled and said, 'Nice day isn't it?'
example_translation: 等公車時，一位老先生笑著說：『今天天氣不錯，對吧？』

definition: 表示自己也持有相同看法
example: 'This room needs more light.' 'I think so too,' the designer replied.
example_translation: 『這個房間需要更多光線。』『我也這麼認為。』設計師回答。

definition: （口語）表示某事荒唐、驚人或難以置信
example: When Pia told us the taxi fare, Ben exclaimed, 'That's crazy.'
example_translation: 皮雅告訴我們計程車費時，班驚呼：『太誇張了。』

definition: 要對方注意看接下來的動作或展示
example: At the skate park, Leo called to his brother, 'Watch this!'
example_translation: 在滑板場，里歐朝哥哥喊道：『看好了！』

definition: 請對方靠近一些
example: The jeweler held up the tiny engraving and said, 'Come closer and look.'
example_translation: 珠寶商舉起細小的刻字說：『靠近一點看。』

definition: 表示對方突然出現或行動嚇到自己
example: When Nia stepped from behind the curtain, I gasped, 'You scared me.'
example_translation: 妮雅從窗簾後走出來時，我倒抽一口氣說：『你嚇到我了。』

definition: 提議暫停工作或活動，稍作休息
example: After two hours of painting, Ava said, 'Let's take a break and get some water.'
example_translation: 畫了兩小時後，艾娃說：『我們休息一下，去喝點水吧。』

definition: 表示由對方作主，也可能帶玩笑語氣
example: 'Should we take the scenic route?' 'You're the boss,' I told the driver.
example_translation: 『我們要走風景比較美的路嗎？』『你決定。』我對司機說。

definition: 提議現在開始進行某件事
example: Once everyone had the recipe, the chef said, 'Let's get started.'
example_translation: 每個人都拿到食譜後，主廚說：『我們開始吧。』

definition: 表示願意支持、傾聽或陪伴對方
example: After Maya received bad news, her friend said, 'I'm here for you anytime.'
example_translation: 瑪雅收到壞消息後，朋友說：『我隨時都會陪著你。』

definition: 對方雖未能幫上忙，仍表示感謝
example: When the library had no copies left, I said, 'Thanks anyway for checking.'
example_translation: 圖書館已無藏書時，我說：『還是謝謝你幫我查。』

definition: 禮貌回應感謝，表示一點也不麻煩
example: 'Thank you for waiting.' 'Not at all; I arrived early.'
example_translation: 『謝謝你等我。』『一點也不麻煩，我本來就早到。』

definition: 提議或催促大家出發
example: When our train was announced, Dad picked up the bags and said, 'Let's go.'
example_translation: 車站廣播我們的列車時，爸爸拿起行李說：『我們走吧。』

definition: 祝對方玩得開心
example: As the children left for camp, their parents waved and called, 'Have fun!'
example_translation: 孩子們前往營隊時，父母揮手喊道：『玩得開心！』

definition: （口語）請對方稍等，也可要人抓緊
example: When another call came in, the receptionist said, 'Hold on for a moment, please.'
example_translation: 另一通電話打進來時，接待員說：『請稍等一下。』

definition: （口語）請對方等很短的時間
example: Hearing a knock, Mina called from the kitchen, 'Just a sec—my hands are wet.'
example_translation: 聽到敲門聲，米娜從廚房喊道：『等一下，我手還是濕的。』

definition: 表示現在正在下雨
example: Before recess, the teacher looked outside and said, 'It's raining.'
example_translation: 下課前，老師看向窗外說：『正在下雨。』

definition: 禮貌詢問是否可以看一下某物
example: At the antique stall, Rui pointed to a watch and asked, 'Can I have a look?'
example_translation: 在古董攤前，睿指著一只手錶問：『我可以看一下嗎？』

definition: 請對方先聽自己說明某件事
example: When the figures seemed wrong, Dana said, 'Let me explain it step by step.'
example_translation: 數字看似不對時，黛娜說：『讓我一步一步說明。』

definition: 表示自己的護照遺失了
example: At the embassy desk, a worried traveler said, 'I lost my passport yesterday.'
example_translation: 在大使館櫃檯，一名焦急的旅客說：『我昨天弄丟了護照。』

definition: 表示自己的錢包遭人偷走
example: At the police station, Ken reported, 'My wallet was stolen on the train.'
example_translation: 在警察局裡，肯報案說：『我的錢包在火車上被偷了。』

definition: （口語）表示吃得非常飽，再也吃不下
example: After the holiday dinner, Rosa leaned back and said, 'I'm stuffed.'
example_translation: 節日晚餐後，蘿莎往後一靠說：『我吃得太飽了。』

definition: 表示自己剛打了嗝，常用來解釋或道歉
example: At the quiet table, Max covered his mouth and said, 'Sorry, I burped.'
example_translation: 安靜的餐桌上，麥克斯摀住嘴說：『抱歉，我打嗝了。』

definition: 詢問某地目前的天氣狀況
example: Before packing for Oslo, I called Eva and asked, 'How's the weather there?'
example_translation: 去奧斯陸前，我打給伊娃問：『那裡天氣如何？』

definition: 提醒對方該起床了
example: Dad opened the curtains and sang, 'Time to wake up, sleepyhead.'
example_translation: 爸爸拉開窗簾唱道：『小懶蟲，該起床了。』

definition: 提醒或要求對方設定鬧鐘
example: Before bed, Mia said, 'Set the alarm for six so we don't miss the flight.'
example_translation: 睡前，米雅說：『把鬧鐘設在六點，免得錯過班機。』

definition: 詢問對方是否感到飢餓
example: On the drive home, Mum asked the children, 'Are you hungry?'
example_translation: 開車回家途中，媽媽問孩子們：『你們餓了嗎？』

definition: 表示某事目前尚未發生或完成
example: 'Have you ordered dessert?' 'Not yet—we're still deciding.'
example_translation: 『你們點甜點了嗎？』『還沒，我們還在考慮。』

definition: 表示自己餓了、想吃東西
example: After soccer practice, Leo opened the fridge and said, 'I'm hungry.'
example_translation: 足球練習後，里歐打開冰箱說：『我餓了。』

definition: （口語）表示自己也有相同感受或情況
example: 'I'm ready for a break.' 'Me too,' Hana said, closing her laptop.
example_translation: 『我想休息一下了。』『我也是。』花奈說著闔上筆電。

definition: 提議大家開始吃飯
example: When the last guest arrived, our host smiled and said, 'Let's eat.'
example_translation: 最後一位客人抵達後，主人笑著說：『我們開動吧。』

definition: （口語）表示這次由自己付錢請客
example: When the bill arrived, Jo took it and said, 'It's on me tonight.'
example_translation: 帳單送來時，喬拿過來說：『今晚我請客。』

definition: 在店裡表示餐點要內用
example: The cashier asked where I'd eat, and I replied, 'For here, please.'
example_translation: 收銀員問我要在哪裡用餐，我回答：『內用，謝謝。』

definition: 在店裡表示餐點要外帶
example: At the noodle shop, I told the cashier, 'To go, please,' and ordered two bowls.
example_translation: 在麵店裡，我向收銀員說：『外帶，謝謝。』並點了兩碗。

definition: 舉杯時勸大家一口喝完，帶歡慶語氣
example: At the team dinner, Ravi raised his glass and called, 'Bottoms up!'
example_translation: 團隊聚餐時，拉維舉杯喊道：『乾杯！』

definition: 表示食物或飲品的味道很濃烈
example: After sipping the herbal tea, Bea said, 'It tastes strong but pleasant.'
example_translation: 碧雅喝了一口草藥茶後說：『味道很濃，但很順口。』

definition: 詢問對方是否喜歡某物或某次體驗
example: After showing Sam the new logo, the designer asked, 'Do you like it?'
example_translation: 設計師向山姆展示新標誌後問：『你喜歡嗎？』

definition: 表示某事可以接受，或安慰對方不要介意
example: When the child spilled juice, her aunt said, 'It's okay; we can clean it up.'
example_translation: 孩子打翻果汁時，阿姨說：『沒關係，我們可以擦乾淨。』

definition: 詢問對方今天過得如何
example: When Amir came home, his roommate asked, 'How's your day been?'
example_translation: 阿米爾回家時，室友問：『你今天過得如何？』

definition: （口語）表示情況還不錯，但不是極好
example: 'How was your first pottery class?' 'Not bad—I made a small cup.'
example_translation: 『第一堂陶藝課怎麼樣？』『還不錯，我做了個小杯子。』

definition: 道別時祝對方今天過得愉快
example: The bus driver handed back my pass and said, 'Have a good day.'
example_translation: 公車司機把票卡還給我，說：『祝你今天愉快。』

definition: 回應祝福，表示也祝對方同樣如此
example: 'Enjoy your weekend.' 'You too,' I said as I left the office.
example_translation: 『週末愉快。』『你也是。』我說完便離開辦公室。

definition: 禮貌詢問是否可以先離席
example: After finishing dinner, the child asked, 'May I be excused?'
example_translation: 孩子吃完晚餐後問：『我可以先離席嗎？』

definition: 表示歡迎對方自行取用或做某事
example: 'May I borrow this chair?' 'Be my guest,' the librarian replied.
example_translation: 『我可以借這張椅子嗎？』『請便。』圖書館員回答。

definition: 關心地表示對方看起來很疲倦
example: When I arrived after the night shift, Dad said, 'You look tired.'
example_translation: 我上完夜班回家時，爸爸說：『你看起來很累。』

definition: 表示自己想睡、感到睏倦
example: Halfway through the late movie, Nina yawned and said, 'I'm sleepy.'
example_translation: 深夜電影看到一半，妮娜打哈欠說：『我想睡了。』

definition: 表示對方的行為不符合平常作風
example: When Omar forgot her birthday, his sister said, 'That's not like you.'
example_translation: 奧瑪忘了她的生日後，姊姊說：『這不像平常的你。』

definition: 直接要求對方別再打擾自己
example: Upset after the argument, Maya closed her door and said, 'Leave me alone.'
example_translation: 爭吵後心情不好的瑪雅關上門說：『別來煩我。』

definition: （口語）要求對方別再煩自己
example: While studying for finals, Nina shut the door and said, 'Don't bug me for an hour.'
example_translation: 準備期末考時，妮娜關上門說：『一小時內別來煩我。』

definition: 詢問對方的年齡
example: At the playground, one child asked the other, 'How old are you?'
example_translation: 在遊樂場，一個孩子問另一個：『你幾歲？』

definition: 表示對方沒抓到真正重點
example: During the budget debate, Maya sighed, 'That's not the point—we need a safer plan.'
example_translation: 討論預算時，瑪雅嘆道：『重點不在那裡，我們需要更安全的方案。』

definition: 不確定時詢問該如何處理
example: After missing her train, Lia called home and asked, 'What should I do now?'
example_translation: 錯過火車後，莉亞打電話回家問：『我現在該怎麼辦？』

definition: （口語）表示完全不知道
example: 'Where did the spare key go?' 'I have no idea,' Dad admitted.
example_translation: 『備用鑰匙去哪了？』『我完全不知道。』爸爸坦承。

definition: 鼓勵對方維持目前的好表現
example: After seeing my improved grades, my tutor smiled and said, 'Keep it up.'
example_translation: 家教看到我進步的成績後，笑著說：『繼續保持。』

definition: 鼓勵或要求對方再試一次
example: The lock did not open, so the clerk said, 'Try again with the key turned left.'
example_translation: 鎖沒有打開，店員說：『把鑰匙往左轉，再試一次。』

definition: 表示希望對方所說的事成真
example: 'The rain should stop by noon.' 'I hope so—we planned a picnic.'
example_translation: 『中午前雨應該會停。』『希望如此，我們安排了野餐。』

definition: 詢問對方目前是否有空
example: Before calling about the report, Ken texted, 'Are you busy now?'
example_translation: 打電話討論報告前，肯傳訊息問：『你現在忙嗎？』

definition: 表示自己收到一則簡訊
example: At breakfast, Mia checked her phone and said, 'I got a text from the school.'
example_translation: 早餐時，米雅查看手機說：『我收到學校傳來的簡訊。』

definition: 告知馬桶堵塞、無法正常沖水
example: A guest called the front desk and said, 'The toilet is clogged in room twelve.'
example_translation: 房客打給櫃檯說：『十二號房的馬桶堵住了。』

definition: （口語）不太確定地表示同意
example: 'Will this box fit in the car?' 'I guess so, if we fold the seats.'
example_translation: 『這個箱子放得進車裡嗎？』『應該可以，把座椅收起來的話。』

definition: 表示願意接手並負責處理
example: When the printer jammed, Ava said, 'Leave it to me; I fixed it last week.'
example_translation: 印表機卡紙時，艾娃說：『交給我，上週我修過。』

definition: 表示自己會負責處理某事
example: The manager saw the upset customer and said, 'I'll handle it from here.'
example_translation: 經理看到生氣的顧客後說：『接下來由我處理。』

definition: 感謝並稱讚對方十分體貼
example: When our neighbor brought soup, Grandma said, 'You are so kind to remember me.'
example_translation: 鄰居送湯來時，奶奶說：『你還惦記著我，真貼心。』

definition: 承諾會盡自己最大的努力
example: Before her first presentation, Zoe told her boss, 'I'll do my best.'
example_translation: 第一次簡報前，柔伊對老闆說：『我會盡全力。』

definition: 要求對方放開或准許自己離開
example: When the game ended, Ben told his friends, 'Let me go home; it's late.'
example_translation: 比賽結束後，班對朋友說：『讓我回家吧，已經很晚了。』

definition: （口語）表示現在不是合適時機
example: As the baby fell asleep, Mom whispered, 'Not now—we can talk later.'
example_translation: 寶寶剛睡著時，媽媽低聲說：『現在不行，我們晚點再談。』

definition: 婉轉表示現在不做，之後再考慮
example: 'Want another slice of cake?' 'Maybe later; I'm still full.'
example_translation: 『還要一片蛋糕嗎？』『晚點吧，我還很飽。』

definition: （急切口語）叫對方趕快過來
example: When the puppy slipped its leash, Ella shouted, 'Come quick—I need help!'
example_translation: 小狗掙脫牽繩時，艾拉大喊：『快過來，我需要幫忙！』

definition: 表示會立刻去做，不會拖延
example: 'Please send this invoice.' 'Right away,' the assistant replied.
example_translation: 『請寄出這張發票。』『馬上處理。』助理回答。

definition: 道別時祝福對方一切順利
example: Before Omar moved abroad, his teammates wrote, 'All the best in your new job.'
example_translation: 奧瑪搬到國外前，隊友寫道：『祝你新工作一切順利。』

definition: 表示需要時間考慮再答覆
example: The dealer offered a lower price, but I said, 'I'll think about it tonight.'
example_translation: 車商提出較低價格，但我說：『我今晚考慮一下。』

definition: 提議一起找出答案或解法
example: When the tent would not stand, Priya said, 'Let's figure it out together.'
example_translation: 帳篷搭不起來時，普莉雅說：『我們一起想辦法。』

definition: （口語）表示對方沒有理解重點
example: Frustrated by his joke, June said, 'You don't get it—this really matters to me.'
example_translation: 君被他的玩笑惹惱，說：『你根本不懂，這對我真的很重要。』

definition: 表示目前很難確定或下結論
example: Asked when repairs would finish, the mechanic said, 'It's hard to say.'
example_translation: 被問到何時修好時，技師說：『現在很難說。』

definition: 表示某事會延後處理
example: Dad pointed at the dishes, and Leo replied, 'I'll do it later, after homework.'
example_translation: 爸爸指著碗盤，里歐回答：『我寫完作業再洗。』

definition: 詢問對方是否也聽到某聲音
example: In the quiet attic, Sam froze and whispered, 'Do you hear that scratching sound?'
example_translation: 安靜的閣樓裡，山姆僵住低聲問：『你有聽到抓東西的聲音嗎？』

definition: 表示情況沒問題或可以接受
example: When I apologized for the small scratch, the owner said, 'It's fine; don't worry.'
example_translation: 我為小刮痕道歉時，屋主說：『沒關係，別擔心。』

definition: （口語）表示一切正常、沒有問題
example: The technician restarted the router and said, 'All good—the signal is back.'
example_translation: 技師重新啟動路由器後說：『都好了，訊號恢復了。』

definition: 詢問眼前事物是什麼
example: The child held up an unfamiliar tool and asked, 'What is this used for?'
example_translation: 孩子舉起陌生工具問：『這是做什麼用的？』

definition: 提醒對方小心腳下
example: As we crossed the wet kitchen floor, the chef warned, 'Watch your step.'
example_translation: 我們走過濕滑的廚房地板時，主廚提醒：『小心腳下。』

definition: 沒聽清楚時請對方再說一次
example: The café was noisy, so I asked the server, 'Can you repeat that, please?'
example_translation: 咖啡館很吵，所以我請服務生：『可以再說一次嗎？』

definition: 表示自己不知道答案或資訊
example: 'Which bus goes downtown?' 'I don't know,' the tourist admitted.
example_translation: 『哪班公車到市中心？』『我不知道。』那名旅客坦承。

definition: 詢問對方居住的地方
example: While filling out the form, the nurse asked, 'Where do you live now?'
example_translation: 填寫表格時，護理師問：『你現在住哪裡？』

definition: 表示不必理會剛才的話或請求
example: I found my glasses and told my roommate, 'Never mind—I have them.'
example_translation: 我找到眼鏡後對室友說：『不用管了，我找到了。』

definition: 詢問對方是否會說英語
example: Lost at the station, Hana approached a guard and asked, 'Do you speak English?'
example_translation: 花奈在車站迷路，便上前問警衛：『你會說英語嗎？』

definition: （口語）婉轉表示不太是或不太會
example: 'Do you enjoy horror films?' 'Not really; they keep me awake.'
example_translation: 『你喜歡恐怖片嗎？』『不太喜歡，它們會讓我睡不著。』

definition: 詢問對方的意見或看法
example: The designer showed us two logos and asked, 'What do you think of the blue one?'
example_translation: 設計師給我們看兩個標誌，問：『你們覺得藍色那個如何？』

definition: 直接表示自己沒有興趣
example: When the salesperson offered another plan, I said, 'I'm not interested, thank you.'
example_translation: 業務員又推一個方案時，我說：『我沒興趣，謝謝。』

definition: 表示自己口渴、想喝東西
example: After the long bike ride, Max said, 'I'm thirsty—can we stop for water?'
example_translation: 騎了很久的腳踏車後，麥克斯說：『我好渴，可以停下來喝水嗎？』

definition: 詢問陌生人的身分
example: Hearing someone at the back door, Mia called, 'Who are you?'
example_translation: 聽到後門有人，米雅喊道：『你是誰？』

definition: 確認對方所說的內容正確
example: 'The meeting starts at nine, correct?' 'That's right,' Mina replied.
example_translation: 『會議九點開始，對嗎？』『沒錯。』米娜回答。

definition: （口語）表示沒什麼事或數量不多
example: 'What did you do this weekend?' 'Not much—I mostly rested.'
example_translation: 『你週末做了什麼？』『沒什麼，大多在休息。』

definition: 提醒對方襯衫穿反了
example: Before the family photo, Ana whispered, 'Your shirt's inside out.'
example_translation: 拍全家福前，安娜低聲提醒：『你的襯衫穿反了。』

definition: （口語）強烈表示絕不可能或拒絕
example: 'Will Dad let us drive his new car?' 'Not a chance,' Leo laughed.
example_translation: 『爸爸會讓我們開他的新車嗎？』『絕對不可能。』里歐笑道。

definition: （簡短口語）詢問對方是否需要幫忙
example: Seeing a shopper reach for a high shelf, the clerk asked, 'Need help?'
example_translation: 店員看到顧客伸手拿高處商品，便問：『需要幫忙嗎？』

definition: 直接請求對方協助自己
example: When the suitcase jammed, Nora called to her brother, 'Help me open this.'
example_translation: 行李箱卡住時，諾拉對哥哥喊：『幫我打開這個。』

definition: 表示某個物品已損壞
example: The child pressed the toy's button and said, 'It's broken; nothing happens.'
example_translation: 孩子按下玩具按鈕說：『它壞了，完全沒反應。』

definition: 要求或安撫對方冷靜下來
example: During the fire drill, the teacher said, 'Calm down and follow me outside.'
example_translation: 消防演習時，老師說：『冷靜下來，跟我到外面。』

definition: 主動把自己的東西讓給對方用
example: When Ella forgot a pen, I said, 'Take mine; I brought an extra.'
example_translation: 艾拉忘了帶筆時，我說：『拿我的吧，我多帶了一支。』

definition: 稱讚對方提出的主意很好
example: 'Let's cook at home tonight.' 'Great idea—we can try that new recipe.'
example_translation: 『今晚在家煮吧。』『好主意，我們可以試試新食譜。』

definition: （口語）稱讚對方貼心又可愛
example: When Ben saved me the last cookie, I smiled and said, 'You're sweet.'
example_translation: 班把最後一塊餅乾留給我時，我笑著說：『你真貼心。』

definition: 緊急提醒對方當心危險
example: A ball flew toward the picnic table, and Dad shouted, 'Watch out!'
example_translation: 一顆球飛向野餐桌，爸爸大喊：『小心！』

definition: 提醒對方做事時注意安全
example: As Nina climbed the ladder, her coworker called, 'Be careful up there.'
example_translation: 妮娜爬梯子時，同事喊道：『在上面要小心。』

definition: 請對方打電話給自己
example: Before leaving the clinic, the doctor said, 'Call me if the fever returns.'
example_translation: 離開診所前，醫師說：『如果又發燒就打給我。』

definition: 請對方傳訊息給自己
example: 'Text me when you reach the hotel,' Mia told her sister.
example_translation: 米雅對姊姊說：『到飯店後傳訊息給我。』

definition: （口語）表示強烈拒絕或難以置信
example: 'You met your favorite singer?' 'No way—show me the photo!'
example_translation: 『你見到最喜歡的歌手了？』『不會吧，給我看照片！』

definition: 詢問該往哪個方向走
example: At the fork in the trail, Omar stopped and asked, 'Which way now?'
example_translation: 走到步道岔路時，奧瑪停下問：『現在走哪邊？』

definition: 指示對方繼續直走
example: The guard pointed down the hall and said, 'Go straight to the glass doors.'
example_translation: 警衛指著走廊說：『直走到玻璃門那裡。』

definition: 指示對方向左轉
example: After the pharmacy, the driver said, 'Turn left at the next light.'
example_translation: 經過藥局後，司機說：『下一個紅綠燈左轉。』

definition: 指示對方向右轉
example: The map showed, 'Turn right after the bridge to reach the farm.'
example_translation: 地圖顯示：『過橋後右轉即可抵達農場。』

definition: 詢問距離或還要走多遠
example: With the children getting tired, Mom asked the guide, 'How far is the lake?'
example_translation: 孩子們走累了，媽媽問嚮導：『湖還有多遠？』

definition: 要求在目前位置停下
example: As the taxi reached my building, I told the driver, 'Stop here, please.'
example_translation: 計程車抵達我家大樓時，我對司機說：『請停這裡。』

definition: 稱讚對方做得很好
example: After the apprentice repaired the chair, the carpenter said, 'Good job.'
example_translation: 學徒修好椅子後，木匠說：『做得好。』

definition: （口語）表示驚訝、不敢相信對方
example: 'Our flight was upgraded for free.' 'You're kidding!' Mia exclaimed.
example_translation: 『我們免費升等了。』『你在開玩笑吧！』米雅驚呼。

definition: （口語）表示當真，也可強調完全同意
example: 'This suitcase is heavy.' 'No kidding—I can barely lift it.'
example_translation: 『這個行李箱真重。』『可不是嗎，我幾乎抬不動。』

definition: 表示非常期待某件即將發生的事
example: After booking the cabin, Zoe said, 'I can't wait for our mountain trip.'
example_translation: 訂好小木屋後，柔伊說：『我等不及去山上旅行了。』

definition: 要求對方誠實說出真相
example: When the vase disappeared, Dad said, 'Tell me the truth—what happened?'
example_translation: 花瓶不見時，爸爸說：『告訴我實話，發生了什麼事？』

definition: （口語）請對方稍等一下
example: While unlocking the shop, the owner said, 'Give me a second; the key is stuck.'
example_translation: 店主開門時說：『等我一下，鑰匙卡住了。』

definition: 詢問對方來自哪裡
example: At the language exchange, Luis asked his partner, 'Where are you from?'
example_translation: 語言交換活動中，路易斯問搭檔：『你來自哪裡？』

definition: 表示尺寸合適或正好放得下
example: Maya tried on the helmet and smiled, 'It fits perfectly.'
example_translation: 瑪雅試戴安全帽後笑說：『大小剛剛好。』

definition: 表示衣物或物品尺寸太緊
example: In the fitting room, Jon tugged at the collar and said, 'Too tight.'
example_translation: 試衣間裡，喬恩拉了拉衣領說：『太緊了。』

definition: 表示衣物或物品尺寸太鬆
example: The skates wobbled on Ava's feet, so she said, 'Too loose—may I try a smaller pair?'
example_translation: 冰鞋在艾娃腳上晃動，她說：『太鬆了，可以換小一號嗎？』

definition: 表示贊同對方的看法或建議
example: After reviewing the schedule, Chen nodded and said, 'I agree with the new plan.'
example_translation: 看過時程後，陳點頭說：『我同意新方案。』

definition: 表示不贊同對方的說法或決定
example: During the committee vote, Rosa said, 'I disagree with cutting the library hours.'
example_translation: 委員會表決時，蘿莎說：『我不同意縮短圖書館開放時間。』

definition: （口語）表示沒人能確定答案
example: 'Will the old team reunite someday?' 'Who knows—anything can happen.'
example_translation: 『老團隊有天會重聚嗎？』『誰知道，什麼都有可能。』

definition: 詢問目前發生了什麼事
example: Seeing everyone leave the office, I asked, 'What's going on downstairs?'
example_translation: 看到大家離開辦公室，我問：『樓下發生什麼事？』

definition: （口語）表示已著手處理某事
example: 'We need more chairs in room four.' 'I'm on it,' the assistant replied.
example_translation: 『四號房需要更多椅子。』『我這就處理。』助理回答。

definition: 提醒對方保持專注、不受干擾
example: During the final lap, the coach called, 'Stay focused on your pace.'
example_translation: 最後一圈時，教練喊道：『專心維持你的速度。』

definition: 鼓勵對方繼續前進或做下去
example: Halfway through the hike, our guide smiled and said, 'Keep going—we're close.'
example_translation: 健行走到一半時，嚮導笑說：『繼續走，我們快到了。』

definition: 表示自己感到疲累
example: After cleaning the garage all morning, Dad sighed, 'I'm tired.'
example_translation: 整理了一早上的車庫後，爸爸嘆道：『我累了。』

definition: 表示自己需要休息一下
example: After the night shift, Priya told her family, 'I need some rest.'
example_translation: 上完夜班後，普莉雅對家人說：『我需要休息一下。』

definition: 詢問還有什麼其他內容或需求
example: The grocer packed the apples and asked, 'What else do you need today?'
example_translation: 雜貨店員裝好蘋果後問：『你今天還需要什麼？』

definition: 表示目前就先到這裡
example: At the end of training, the instructor said, 'That's all for now; see you Friday.'
example_translation: 訓練結束時，講師說：『目前就到這裡，週五見。』

definition: 確認對方是否理解內容
example: After explaining the safety rule, Mom asked, 'Do you understand why it matters?'
example_translation: 說明安全規則後，媽媽問：『你明白它為何重要嗎？』

definition: 表示自己已經理解
example: The nurse explained the medicine schedule, and I replied, 'I understand.'
example_translation: 護理師說明服藥時間後，我回答：『我明白了。』

definition: 提議大家現在開始
example: Once every guest was seated, the host smiled and said, 'Let's begin.'
example_translation: 所有賓客就座後，主持人微笑說：『我們開始吧。』

definition: 表示正專心聽，請對方繼續說
example: Ana put down her phone and told her son, 'I'm listening—tell me what happened.'
example_translation: 安娜放下手機對兒子說：『我在聽，告訴我發生了什麼。』

definition: 提醒對方三思後再行動
example: Before Leo quit his job, his sister warned, 'Think twice about that decision.'
example_translation: 里歐辭職前，姊姊提醒：『那個決定要三思。』

definition: （口語）請對方讓自己看看或想一下
example: When the receipt looked wrong, the cashier said, 'Let me see it again.'
example_translation: 收據看來有誤時，收銀員說：『讓我再看一下。』

definition: （口語）表示某事不重要或自己不在乎
example: 'Your socks don't match.' 'Who cares? I'm staying home today.'
example_translation: 『你的襪子不成對。』『誰在乎？我今天待在家。』

definition: 勸對方放輕鬆或別太勉強
example: Seeing Max work through lunch, his colleague said, 'Take it easy this afternoon.'
example_translation: 看到麥克斯午餐時間仍工作，同事說：『下午放輕鬆點。』

definition: 承認對方所說的確實如此
example: 'The cheaper route takes longer.' 'That's true, but we have time.'
example_translation: 『便宜的路線比較久。』『沒錯，但我們有時間。』

definition: 勸對方放下此事並繼續前進
example: After discussing the error, the chairperson said, 'Move on to the next item.'
example_translation: 討論完錯誤後，主席說：『接著進行下一項。』

definition: 要求對方留在原地
example: The ranger told the children, 'Stay here while I check the bridge.'
example_translation: 巡護員對孩子們說：『留在這裡，我去檢查那座橋。』

definition: （禮貌口語）表示自己不太願意
example: 'Would you like to speak on camera?' 'I'd rather not, if that's okay.'
example_translation: 『你願意對著鏡頭發言嗎？』『可以的話，我不太想。』

definition: 轉換話題時順帶提起另一件事
example: As we left the café, Mia said, 'By the way, your book is in my bag.'
example_translation: 我們離開咖啡館時，米雅說：『對了，你的書在我包包裡。』

definition: （口語）表示省略或不做某件事
example: The dessert menu was expensive, so Dad said, 'Skip it; we have cake at home.'
example_translation: 甜點菜單太貴，爸爸說：『算了，家裡有蛋糕。』

definition: 要求對方接起電話
example: While I was cooking, I asked Leo, 'Answer the phone, please.'
example_translation: 我做飯時請里歐：『請接一下電話。』

definition: 請對方在無人接聽時留言
example: The clinic recording said, 'Leave a message after the tone.'
example_translation: 診所的錄音說：『請在提示音後留言。』

definition: 通話或訊息中詢問對方身分
example: I answered the unfamiliar call and asked, 'Who's this, please?'
example_translation: 我接起陌生來電問：『請問哪位？』

definition: 表明來者或通話者是自己
example: From outside the locked door, Ben called, 'It's me—can you let me in?'
example_translation: 班在鎖上的門外喊：『是我，可以讓我進去嗎？』

definition: 告知對方打錯電話了
example: After a stranger asked for Carla, I said, 'Wrong number, sorry.'
example_translation: 陌生人找卡拉時，我說：『抱歉，你打錯了。』

definition: 請對方稍後再打電話
example: The receptionist was with a client, so she said, 'Call back later this afternoon.'
example_translation: 接待員正在接待客戶，所以說：『今天下午晚點再打來。』

definition: （口語）大約詢問時間點
example: 'The plumber will arrive this afternoon.' 'About when should I expect him?'
example_translation: 『水電工下午會到。』『大約幾點會來？』

definition: 詢問某段內容或事物的意思
example: Pointing at a road sign, the tourist asked, 'What does this mean?'
example_translation: 旅客指著路標問：『這是什麼意思？』

definition: 邀請對方到自己這裡或家裡
example: After baking too many muffins, Zoe texted, 'Come over and take some home.'
example_translation: 柔伊烤了太多瑪芬，傳訊息說：『過來拿一些回家吧。』

definition: 要求對方開始準備
example: Dad checked the train time and called upstairs, 'Get ready—we leave at eight.'
example_translation: 爸爸查看火車時間後朝樓上喊：『準備好，我們八點出發。』

definition: 鼓勵對方盡力而為
example: Before the spelling contest, Mom hugged Eli and said, 'Try your best.'
example_translation: 拼字比賽前，媽媽抱著伊萊說：『盡力就好。』

definition: （簡短口語）表示想念對方
example: On her first night away, Ava texted her family, 'Miss you already.'
example_translation: 離家的第一晚，艾娃傳訊息給家人：『已經開始想你們了。』

definition: （口語）引出令人意外或興奮的消息
example: Nora burst into the kitchen and said, 'Guess what—I got the internship!'
example_translation: 諾拉衝進廚房說：『你猜怎樣，我拿到實習了！』

definition: 請對方把事情說給自己聽
example: Seeing his worried face, June said, 'Tell me what happened at school.'
example_translation: 看到他憂心的表情，君說：『告訴我學校發生了什麼。』

definition: 詢問今天是否會下雨
example: Before hanging laundry outside, Grandma asked, 'Will it rain today?'
example_translation: 把衣服晾到外面前，奶奶問：『今天會下雨嗎？』

definition: 表示會開車或前往接對方
example: When Lia's shift ended late, her brother said, 'I'll pick you up at ten.'
example_translation: 莉亞晚班結束較晚，哥哥說：『我十點去接你。』

definition: 指出對方比約定時間晚到
example: When Omar entered the rehearsal, the director said, 'You're late again.'
example_translation: 奧瑪走進排練場時，導演說：『你又遲到了。』

definition: （口語）對壞事重演表示懊惱
example: The printer jammed for the third time, and Mia groaned, 'Not again!'
example_translation: 印表機第三次卡紙，米雅呻吟道：『怎麼又來了！』

definition: 表示某件事令自己意外
example: When the quiet café filled up, the owner admitted, 'I was surprised by the crowd.'
example_translation: 安靜的咖啡館坐滿人時，老闆坦言：『這麼多人讓我很意外。』

definition: （不客氣口語）反問對方為何多管
example: When a stranger questioned her purchase, Ana snapped, 'What's it to you?'
example_translation: 陌生人質問安娜買了什麼，她不耐地回道：『關你什麼事？』

definition: 要求對方在此處等候
example: At the museum entrance, Dad told us, 'Wait here while I buy tickets.'
example_translation: 在博物館入口，爸爸說：『在這裡等，我去買票。』

definition: 鼓勵困境中的人再撐一下
example: During the steep climb, our guide called, 'Hang in there—the top is close.'
example_translation: 爬上陡坡時，嚮導喊道：『撐住，山頂快到了。』

definition: 要求對方投入更多努力
example: When the first draft lacked detail, the editor said, 'Try harder on the conclusion.'
example_translation: 初稿細節不足時，編輯說：『結論部分再多下點功夫。』

definition: 要求對方保持原位不動
example: While removing a splinter, Mom told the child, 'Don't move your hand.'
example_translation: 媽媽替孩子拔刺時說：『手不要動。』

definition: 警告對方別靠近危險區域
example: As sparks flew from the wire, the electrician shouted, 'Stay back!'
example_translation: 電線冒出火花時，電工大喊：『退後！』

definition: 要求對方待命或稍候
example: The producer told the camera crew, 'Stand by for the live announcement.'
example_translation: 製作人對攝影團隊說：『待命，準備現場公告。』

definition: 提醒對方維持冷靜
example: When turbulence shook the plane, the attendant said, 'Keep calm and stay seated.'
example_translation: 飛機遇到亂流時，空服員說：『保持冷靜並坐在位子上。』

definition: 詢問對方平時的興趣
example: At the new-student lunch, Leo asked his classmate, 'What's your hobby?'
example_translation: 新生午餐會上，里歐問同學：『你的興趣是什麼？』

definition: （口語）請對方舉例說明
example: 'We need more outdoor activities.' 'Like what?' the camp leader asked.
example_translation: 『我們需要更多戶外活動。』『例如什麼？』營隊領隊問。

definition: 直接要求對方離開
example: The raccoon approached the bins, and Dad clapped and shouted, 'Go away!'
example_translation: 浣熊靠近垃圾桶時，爸爸拍手大喊：『走開！』

definition: 表示自己正在忙，暫時沒空
example: When her friend called during class, Nina texted, 'I'm busy—talk later.'
example_translation: 朋友在上課時打來，妮娜傳訊息說：『我在忙，晚點聊。』

definition: 請對方四處看看或查看環境
example: The realtor opened the apartment door and said, 'Look around at your own pace.'
example_translation: 房仲打開公寓大門說：『請按自己的步調四處看看。』

definition: 表示自己趕時間
example: At the crowded counter, Ben said, 'I'm in a hurry; could I pay now?'
example_translation: 在擁擠的櫃檯前，班說：『我趕時間，可以現在結帳嗎？』

definition: 要求對方讓到一旁
example: The paramedic faced the crowd and said, 'Step aside and give us room.'
example_translation: 救護員面向人群說：『讓到旁邊，給我們一些空間。』

definition: 要求對方跟著自己走
example: The hostess picked up two menus and said, 'Follow me to your table.'
example_translation: 帶位員拿起兩份菜單說：『請跟我到座位。』

definition: 請對方挪出一些空間
example: On the crowded sofa, Maya told her brother, 'Move over so Grandma can sit.'
example_translation: 擁擠的沙發上，瑪雅對哥哥說：『挪一下，讓奶奶坐。』

definition: 表示某事就快完成了
example: When the children asked about dinner, Dad called, 'Almost done—set the table.'
example_translation: 孩子們問晚餐好了沒，爸爸喊道：『快好了，去擺桌子。』

definition: 表示停止嘗試或承認無法解決
example: After an hour on the puzzle, Sam sighed, 'I give up—show me the answer.'
example_translation: 解了一小時謎題後，山姆嘆道：『我放棄了，告訴我答案吧。』

definition: 表示已經足夠，要求停止
example: When the children began shouting, their teacher said, 'That's enough—quiet down.'
example_translation: 孩子們開始大叫時，老師說：『夠了，安靜下來。』

definition: 要對方拿著或收下某物
example: Before the hike, Lia handed me a bottle and said, 'Take this for the trail.'
example_translation: 健行前，莉亞遞給我一瓶水說：『路上帶著這個。』

definition: （口語）伸手擊掌慶祝或鼓勵
example: After our team scored, the coach grinned and said, 'Give me five!'
example_translation: 我們隊得分後，教練笑著說：『來，擊個掌！』

definition: 表示自己已經準備好了
example: When the driving instructor arrived, Zoe buckled up and said, 'I'm ready.'
example_translation: 駕駛教練到達後，柔伊繫好安全帶說：『我準備好了。』

definition: 要求對方回來
example: As her son ran toward the gate, Mom called, 'Come back and get your coat.'
example_translation: 兒子跑向大門時，媽媽喊：『回來拿外套。』

definition: 表示某件東西屬於自己
example: When the clerk held up a red scarf, Ava said, 'It's mine—I left it here.'
example_translation: 店員舉起紅圍巾時，艾娃說：『那是我的，我忘在這裡了。』

definition: 表示某件東西屬於對方
example: Dad handed me the old camera and said, 'It's yours now; take good care of it.'
example_translation: 爸爸把舊相機交給我說：『現在它是你的了，要好好愛惜。』

definition: 要求對方展示或示範給自己看
example: When Kai mentioned a new card trick, I said, 'Show me how it works.'
example_translation: 凱提到新的紙牌魔術時，我說：『示範給我看怎麼變。』

definition: 要求對方從選項中選一個
example: The baker pointed to three cupcakes and told the child, 'Pick one.'
example_translation: 麵包師指著三個杯子蛋糕對孩子說：『選一個吧。』

definition: 表示某件事很困難
example: Learning the first chord, Mia frowned and said, 'It's hard to stretch my fingers.'
example_translation: 學第一個和弦時，米雅皺眉說：『手指要張開很難。』

definition: 表示某件事很簡單
example: The clerk demonstrated the scanner and said, 'It's easy once you try it.'
example_translation: 店員示範掃描器後說：『試過一次就很簡單。』

definition: 把決定權交給對方
example: 'Should we eat noodles or rice?' 'You decide; I like both.'
example_translation: 『我們吃麵還是飯？』『你決定，我都喜歡。』

definition: 表示自己感到困惑、不明白
example: After reading two different schedules, Omar said, 'I'm confused about the start time.'
example_translation: 看了兩份不同時程後，奧瑪說：『我搞不清楚開始時間。』

definition: 警告或要求對方不要碰某物
example: The museum guard pointed at the sculpture and said, 'Don't touch the artwork.'
example_translation: 博物館警衛指著雕塑說：『請勿觸摸藝術品。』

definition: （口語）催促對方直接離開或去做
example: When Leo kept hesitating at the door, his sister said, 'Just go—you'll miss the bus.'
example_translation: 里歐一直在門口猶豫，姊姊說：『快走吧，不然會錯過公車。』

definition: 安慰對方不必擔心
example: When the cake cracked, Grandma smiled and said, 'Don't worry; it will still taste good.'
example_translation: 蛋糕裂開時，奶奶笑說：『別擔心，味道還是會很好。』

definition: 鄭重保證自己會做到某事
example: Before borrowing the bike, Max said, 'I promise I'll return it before dark.'
example_translation: 借腳踏車前，麥克斯說：『我保證天黑前會還。』

definition: 表示自己迷路或不知道方向
example: At the station, a traveler showed me a map and said, 'I'm lost.'
example_translation: 車站裡，一名旅客拿著地圖對我說：『我迷路了。』

definition: 要求對方不要說謊
example: When the cookies vanished, Dad told the children, 'Don't lie about what happened.'
example_translation: 餅乾不見時，爸爸對孩子們說：『不要對發生的事說謊。』

definition: 要求對方坦白誠實
example: The doctor asked about my habits and said, 'Be honest so I can help you.'
example_translation: 醫師詢問我的習慣並說：『請說實話，我才能幫你。』

definition: 表示不再接受任何藉口
example: After the third missed deadline, the manager said, 'No more excuses—finish it today.'
example_translation: 第三次錯過期限後，經理說：『別再找藉口，今天完成。』

definition: 表示某事不合邏輯或難以理解
example: After comparing the two bills, Priya said, 'It doesn't make sense that we paid twice.'
example_translation: 比對兩張帳單後，普莉雅說：『我們付了兩次，這不合理。』

definition: 表示自己正在生氣
example: When someone scratched his car, Ben said, 'I'm mad, but I'll stay calm.'
example_translation: 有人刮傷班的車時，他說：『我很生氣，但我會保持冷靜。』

definition: 邀請或要求對方一起走
example: As the family left for the market, Mom said, 'Come along with us, Mia.'
example_translation: 家人準備去市場時，媽媽說：『米雅，跟我們一起來吧。』

definition: 催促對方快一點
example: The train was approaching, so Kai called, 'Hurry up or we'll miss it!'
example_translation: 火車快進站了，凱喊道：『快點，不然會錯過！』

definition: 緊急警告對方注意危險
example: A cyclist sped around the corner, and Nina shouted, 'Look out!'
example_translation: 一名騎士快速轉過街角，妮娜大喊：『小心！』

definition: 提議一起談談並處理問題
example: After the siblings argued, Dad said, 'Let's talk about it after dinner.'
example_translation: 手足爭吵後，爸爸說：『我們晚餐後談談這件事。』

definition: 承認自己犯了錯
example: The cashier checked the change and said, 'I made a mistake—here's the rest.'
example_translation: 收銀員核對找零後說：『我弄錯了，這是少找的錢。』

definition: 安慰對方不要難過
example: When the balloon popped, Grandpa said, 'Don't be sad; we'll get another one.'
example_translation: 氣球破掉時，爺爺說：『別難過，我們再買一個。』

definition: 強硬要求對方離自己遠一點
example: After the stranger followed her, Ana turned and shouted, 'Stay away from me!'
example_translation: 陌生人尾隨安娜時，她轉身大喊：『離我遠一點！』

definition: 要求對方往後退一步或保持距離
example: As the train arrived, the guard told everyone, 'Step back from the platform edge.'
example_translation: 火車進站時，警衛提醒大家：『從月台邊緣往後退。』

definition: 要求對方負責處理某事
example: When a pipe began leaking, the landlord told the plumber, 'Take care of it today.'
example_translation: 水管開始漏水時，房東對水電工說：『今天把它處理好。』

definition: 表示某事不值得花時間或冒險
example: Seeing the icy shortcut, Lia said, 'It's not worth it—let's take the main road.'
example_translation: 看到結冰的捷徑，莉亞說：『不值得冒險，我們走大路吧。』

definition: 提議大家繼續前進別停下
example: Dark clouds gathered above the trail, so our guide said, 'Let's keep moving.'
example_translation: 步道上方烏雲聚集，嚮導說：『我們繼續往前走。』

definition: 表示願意照辦，也可能帶敷衍語氣
example: Too tired to debate dinner plans, Jon sighed, 'Anything you say.'
example_translation: 喬恩累得不想爭論晚餐安排，嘆道：『都聽你的。』

definition: 表示牛奶已經變質
example: After smelling the carton, Dad frowned and said, 'The milk went bad.'
example_translation: 爸爸聞了紙盒後皺眉說：『牛奶壞掉了。』

definition: （口語）驚訝地追問從何時開始
example: 'Leo can bake bread now.' 'Since when?' his sister asked.
example_translation: 『里歐現在會烤麵包了。』『從什麼時候開始的？』姊姊問。

definition: 要求對方降低音量
example: In the hospital hallway, the nurse whispered, 'Keep your voice down, please.'
example_translation: 在醫院走廊，護理師低聲說：『請小聲一點。』

definition: 表示某件事不是自己的責任
example: When the outdoor show was canceled by rain, the organizer said, 'It's not my fault.'
example_translation: 戶外表演因雨取消時，主辦人說：『這不是我的錯。』

definition: （口語）表示不相信某個說法
example: After hearing his weak excuse, Maya said, 'I don't buy it—tell me what really happened.'
example_translation: 聽到他站不住腳的藉口後，瑪雅說：『我不信，說出真相。』

definition: 表示自己很確定
example: When Nina doubted the address, I said, 'I'm sure this is the right building.'
example_translation: 妮娜懷疑地址時，我說：『我確定就是這棟大樓。』

definition: （口語）簡短承認是自己的錯
example: After taking the wrong mug, Sam said, 'My bad—I thought it was mine.'
example_translation: 山姆拿錯杯子後說：『我的錯，我以為是我的。』

definition: 用來向對方道歉或表示遺憾
example: After stepping on her foot, I said, 'I'm sorry—are you okay?'
example_translation: 踩到她的腳後，我說：『對不起，你還好嗎？』

definition: 回應感謝或表示事情不麻煩
example: 'Thanks for carrying the bags.' 'No problem,' the neighbor replied.
example_translation: 『謝謝你幫忙提袋子。』『不客氣。』鄰居回答。

definition: （隨意口語）表示不是什麼大事
example: When I apologized for being five minutes late, Ava said, 'No biggie.'
example_translation: 我為遲到五分鐘道歉時，艾娃說：『沒什麼大不了。』

definition: 宣布自己贏得比賽或遊戲
example: When her last card matched, the child jumped up and shouted, 'I win!'
example_translation: 最後一張牌配對成功時，孩子跳起來喊：『我贏了！』

definition: 表示覺得某個消息或結果很好
example: 'The shelter found the puppy a home.' 'That's great news!' Mia said.
example_translation: 『收容所替小狗找到家了。』『那太好了！』米雅說。

definition: （口語）稱讚對方表現完全到位
example: After Zoe finished the difficult solo, her teacher said, 'You nailed it.'
example_translation: 柔伊完成高難度獨奏後，老師說：『你表現得完美極了。』

definition: 要求某事在最短時間內完成
example: 'As soon as possible,' the doctor said, 'send me the test results.'
example_translation: 醫師說：『請盡快把檢驗結果送給我。』

definition: 禮貌回應對方的感謝
example: 'Thank you for the directions.' 'You're welcome,' the clerk said.
example_translation: 『謝謝你指路。』『不客氣。』店員說。

definition: 要求對方相信自己的判斷或承諾
example: At the unfamiliar restaurant, Leo said, 'Trust me—the noodles here are excellent.'
example_translation: 在陌生餐廳裡，里歐說：『相信我，這裡的麵非常好吃。』

definition: 強調自己所說的話是真的
example: When no one believed her story, Ana said, 'I swear I saw a deer outside.'
example_translation: 沒人相信安娜的故事時，她說：『我發誓真的看到外面有鹿。』

definition: 詢問出口的位置
example: When the alarm sounded, a visitor asked the guard, 'Where is the exit?'
example_translation: 警報響起時，一名訪客問警衛：『出口在哪裡？』

definition: （口語）表示只是確認一下
example: I opened the oven and said, 'Just checking whether the bread is ready.'
example_translation: 我打開烤箱說：『只是確認麵包烤好了沒。』

definition: 表示湯的溫度很燙
example: The server set down the bowl and warned, 'This soup is hot, so be careful.'
example_translation: 服務生放下碗提醒：『這碗湯很燙，請小心。』

definition: 用餐時禮貌請人遞鹽
example: At the family dinner, Grandpa asked, 'Please pass the salt, Mia.'
example_translation: 家庭晚餐時，爺爺說：『米雅，請把鹽遞過來。』

definition: 表示牛肉口感柔嫩
example: After tasting the stew, the chef smiled and said, 'The beef is tender now.'
example_translation: 主廚嚐了燉肉後笑說：『牛肉現在很嫩了。』

definition: 邀請對方品嚐或使用一些
example: Maya offered me the fruit salad and said, 'Try some—it's fresh.'
example_translation: 瑪雅把水果沙拉遞給我說：『嚐一些吧，很新鮮。』

definition: （口語）爽快表示當然或一定
example: 'Can you help us move Saturday?' 'You bet—I'll bring my truck.'
example_translation: 『你星期六能幫我們搬家嗎？』『當然，我會開卡車來。』

definition: 表示輪到自己做某事
example: At the board game table, Nora reached for the dice and said, 'It's my turn.'
example_translation: 玩桌遊時，諾拉伸手拿骰子說：『輪到我了。』

definition: 表示就是那個，或事情到此結束
example: When the key finally turned, Ben smiled and said, 'That's it—you opened it.'
example_translation: 鑰匙終於轉動時，班笑說：『就是這樣，你打開了。』

definition: 表示自己正在努力嘗試
example: When the coach urged her to speed up, Lia called, 'I'm trying my best!'
example_translation: 教練催她加速時，莉亞喊道：『我正在盡力！』

definition: 表示水已經沸騰
example: From the kitchen, Dad called, 'The water is boiling—bring me the pasta.'
example_translation: 爸爸從廚房喊道：『水滾了，把義大利麵拿來。』

definition: 提醒對方某事需要時間累積
example: When I struggled with piano, my teacher said, 'It takes time to build skill.'
example_translation: 我學鋼琴遇到困難時，老師說：『培養技巧需要時間。』

definition: 承認是自己弄錯或負責
example: After checking the booking, the clerk said, 'My mistake—your room is ready.'
example_translation: 店員核對訂房後說：『是我弄錯了，你的房間準備好了。』

definition: （口語）詢問某事的目的或原因
example: 'I need to borrow your ladder.' 'What for?' Dad asked.
example_translation: 『我需要借你的梯子。』『要做什麼？』爸爸問。

definition: 要求對方蹲下或從高處下來
example: Seeing the child on the fence, Mom shouted, 'Get down from there!'
example_translation: 媽媽看到孩子爬上圍牆，大喊：『快從那裡下來！』

definition: 提醒對方牢牢抓緊
example: As the small boat hit a wave, the guide called, 'Hold on tight!'
example_translation: 小船撞上浪頭時，嚮導喊道：『抓緊！』

definition: （口語）表示該出發上路了
example: After loading the last suitcase, Dad said, 'Hit the road before traffic builds.'
example_translation: 裝好最後一個行李箱後，爸爸說：『趁塞車前上路吧。』

definition: （簡短口語）詢問目的地是哪裡
example: The taxi driver started the meter and asked, 'Where to, ma'am?'
example_translation: 計程車司機按下跳表問：『女士，要去哪裡？』

definition: 要求把油箱加滿
example: Before crossing the desert, Lia told the attendant, 'Fill up the tank, please.'
example_translation: 穿越沙漠前，莉亞對加油員說：『請把油箱加滿。』

definition: 詢問對方是否能找零或有零錢
example: At the market stall, I held out a large bill and asked, 'Do you have change?'
example_translation: 在市場攤位前，我拿出大鈔問：『你有零錢可以找嗎？』

definition: 表示某種可能性確實存在
example: 'Is that noise coming from the heater?' 'It could be,' the technician said.
example_translation: 『那個聲音是暖氣發出的嗎？』『有可能。』技師說。

definition: （口語）告知限定時間已結束，必須停下
example: 'Time's up,' the teacher said. 'Please put down your pencils.'
example_translation: 老師說：『時間到了，請放下鉛筆。』

definition: 要對方耐心等著看結果
example: When the children asked about dessert, Mom smiled, 'Just wait and see.'
example_translation: 孩子們問甜點是什麼時，媽媽笑說：『等著看就知道了。』

definition: 表示電話線路正在通話中
example: After calling the clinic twice, Nina said, 'The line is busy again.'
example_translation: 打了兩次給診所後，妮娜說：『電話又在忙線。』

definition: 禮貌請對方稍等片刻
example: The receptionist checked the schedule and said, 'One moment, please.'
example_translation: 接待員查看時程後說：『請稍等一下。』

definition: 要求對方立刻停止某個行為
example: When the twins splashed water indoors, Dad said, 'Stop it right now.'
example_translation: 雙胞胎在屋內潑水時，爸爸說：『立刻住手。』

definition: 表示認為某事不可能做到或發生
example: When told the parcel arrived overnight, the clerk said, 'That's impossible—we sent it today.'
example_translation: 聽說包裹一夜送達時，店員說：『不可能，我們今天才寄。』

definition: 警告對方說話要有分寸
example: After the rude remark, the coach told the player, 'Watch your mouth.'
example_translation: 球員出言不遜後，教練警告：『說話注意一點。』

definition: 表示已完全明白，不必再解釋
example: 'We need someone to taste the cake.' 'Say no more—I'm ready.'
example_translation: 『我們需要有人試吃蛋糕。』『不用多說，我準備好了。』

definition: 表示忍耐已到極限，必須停止
example: After months of noisy nights, the tenant said, 'Enough is enough—I'm moving.'
example_translation: 忍受數月夜間噪音後，房客說：『受夠了，我要搬走。』

definition: 表示某行為已經太過分
example: When the prank damaged a car, Maya said, 'It's going too far now.'
example_translation: 惡作劇損壞汽車時，瑪雅說：『這已經太過分了。』

definition: 要求情緒激動的人克制自己
example: During the heated match, the referee warned a player, 'Control yourself.'
example_translation: 激烈比賽中，裁判警告一名球員：『控制一下自己。』

definition: 要求對方別辜負自己的信任
example: Before the important delivery, the manager said, 'Don't let me down today.'
example_translation: 重要配送前，經理說：『今天別讓我失望。』

definition: 表示對方正好及時趕到
example: As the doors were closing, Mia smiled, 'You are just in time for the show.'
example_translation: 大門即將關閉時，米雅笑說：『你正好趕上表演。』

definition: （口語）要對方別說傻話或別胡鬧
example: When I offered to pay her back for tea, Ana laughed, 'Don't be silly.'
example_translation: 我說要還安娜茶錢時，她笑道：『別傻了。』

definition: 責備對方的行為不應該
example: When Leo mocked the new student, his sister said, 'Shame on you.'
example_translation: 里歐嘲笑新同學時，姊姊責備：『你真不應該。』

definition: （口語）表示已理解或收到指示
example: The supervisor showed me the switch and asked if I understood; I said, 'Got it.'
example_translation: 主管指給我看開關並確認我是否明白，我回答：『懂了。』

definition: 表示情況迫使自己只能如此
example: With the last bus canceled, Nina sighed, 'I have no choice but to take a taxi.'
example_translation: 末班公車取消後，妮娜嘆道：『我只能搭計程車了。』

definition: 表示結果印證了自己的猜想
example: When the missing cat emerged from the shed, Dad smiled, 'I knew it!'
example_translation: 失蹤的貓從棚子走出來時，爸爸笑說：『我就知道！』

definition: 表示別再提或乾脆算了
example: When the repair cost doubled, Ben said, 'Forget it—I'll buy a new lamp.'
example_translation: 維修費翻倍時，班說：『算了，我買盞新燈。』

definition: 表示不太相信或認為可能性低
example: 'Will the beach be empty today?' 'I doubt it; it's a holiday.'
example_translation: 『今天海灘會沒人嗎？』『我看不會，今天是假日。』

definition: 要求換個話題，不再談目前內容
example: When lunch talk became too personal, Ana said, 'Change the subject, please.'
example_translation: 午餐話題變得太私密時，安娜說：『請換個話題。』

definition: 表示答案要視條件而定
example: 'Can we eat outside?' 'It depends on the weather,' Mom replied.
example_translation: 『我們能在外面吃嗎？』『要看天氣。』媽媽回答。
