definition: （口語）請對方稍等一下
example: As Mia reached for the door, I said, 'Wait a second—you forgot your keys.'
example_translation: 米雅伸手開門時，我說：『等一下，你忘了鑰匙。』

definition: （簡短口語）表示難以判斷
example: Looking at the distant clouds, the sailor said, 'Hard to tell if rain is coming.'
example_translation: 水手望著遠方的雲說：『很難判斷會不會下雨。』

definition: 主動提出要協助對方
example: Seeing Grandma carry two boxes, Max said, 'Let me help you with those.'
example_translation: 看到奶奶搬兩個箱子，麥克斯說：『讓我幫你拿。』

definition: 確認對方是否確定自己的選擇
example: Before deleting the file, the app asked, 'Are you sure you want to continue?'
example_translation: 刪除檔案前，應用程式詢問：『你確定要繼續嗎？』

definition: 傍晚或晚間見面時的問候語
example: As guests entered the restaurant, the host greeted them, 'Good evening.'
example_translation: 客人走進餐廳時，接待員問候：『晚安。』

definition: 提議或要求出去散步
example: After dinner, Dad said, 'Take a walk with me around the block.'
example_translation: 晚餐後，爸爸說：『陪我到街區散散步。』

definition: 表示哪一天都可以配合
example: 'Should we meet Tuesday or Thursday?' 'Any day will do for me.'
example_translation: 『我們週二還是週四見？』『我哪一天都可以。』

definition: 要求對方起床或站起來
example: When the alarm rang, Mom opened the curtains and called, 'Get up, sleepyhead.'
example_translation: 鬧鐘響時，媽媽拉開窗簾喊：『起床了，小瞌睡蟲。』

definition: 請或要求對方坐下
example: The doctor pointed to the chair and said, 'Sit down and rest your ankle.'
example_translation: 醫師指著椅子說：『坐下來，讓腳踝休息。』

definition: （強硬口語）警告對方退開別逼近
example: When the dog growled, its owner warned the stranger, 'Back off slowly.'
example_translation: 狗低吼時，飼主警告陌生人：『慢慢退開。』

definition: （口語）催促、鼓勵或表示不耐
example: As the final runner slowed, her teammates shouted, 'Come on, Mia—you can finish!'
example_translation: 最後一名跑者慢下來時，隊友喊：『加油，米雅，你能跑完！』

definition: （口語）要求對方停止惱人行為
example: When the brothers kept poking each other, Mom said, 'Cut it out, both of you.'
example_translation: 兄弟倆一直互戳時，媽媽說：『你們兩個都住手。』

definition: 責備對方別幼稚，要符合年齡
example: After Ben threw a fit over the game, his friend said, 'Act your age.'
example_translation: 班因遊戲鬧脾氣後，朋友說：『成熟一點。』

definition: 鼓勵對方自然展現真實的自己
example: Before the interview, Ana told her sister, 'Be yourself and speak honestly.'
example_translation: 面試前，安娜對姊姊說：『做你自己，誠實回答。』

definition: 表示結果正如自己先前提醒的那樣
example: When the weak shelf collapsed, Leo muttered, 'I told you so.'
example_translation: 不牢的架子倒下時，里歐嘀咕：『我早就說過了。』

definition: 表示自己遇上麻煩了
example: After losing the office keys, Sam whispered, 'I'm in trouble.'
example_translation: 弄丟辦公室鑰匙後，山姆低聲說：『我有麻煩了。』

definition: 可要求離開，也可驚訝地表示不信
example: When smoke entered the kitchen, the chef shouted, 'Get out of here now!'
example_translation: 煙霧進入廚房時，主廚大喊：『立刻離開這裡！』

definition: 要求對方控制情緒、冷靜下來
example: Before the hearing began, the lawyer told her client, 'Calm yourself and breathe.'
example_translation: 聽證會開始前，律師對當事人說：『冷靜下來，深呼吸。』

definition: 否認某事物或說法根本不存在
example: 'Is there a perfect job?' 'No such thing,' my mentor replied.
example_translation: 『有完美的工作嗎？』『根本沒有這種事。』導師回答。

definition: （口語）表示自己深有同感
example: 'This heat is exhausting.' 'You're telling me—I barely slept.'
example_translation: 『這種熱天真累人。』『可不是嗎，我幾乎沒睡。』

definition: 要求對方別說不吉利或傷人的話
example: When Max predicted another accident, Grandma said, 'Bite your tongue!'
example_translation: 麥克斯預言又會出意外時，奶奶說：『別說這種不吉利的話！』

definition: 請求讓自己嘗試看看
example: When the jar would not open, Zoe held out her hand and said, 'Let me try.'
example_translation: 罐子打不開時，柔伊伸出手說：『讓我試試。』

definition: （口語）表示贊成，或反問為何不行
example: 'Want to join our picnic?' 'Why not? I have no plans.'
example_translation: 『想參加我們的野餐嗎？』『好啊，我沒別的安排。』

definition: （口語）表示願意加入或參加
example: When friends planned a weekend hike, Maya said, 'I'm in—what should I bring?'
example_translation: 朋友計畫週末健行時，瑪雅說：『我參加，要帶什麼？』

definition: （口語）表示退出或不參加
example: When the poker stakes rose, Ben pushed back his chair and said, 'I'm out.'
example_translation: 撲克牌賭注提高時，班把椅子往後推說：『我不玩了。』

definition: 久別重逢時表示很久沒見
example: At the reunion, Nina hugged her old roommate and said, 'It's been a long time.'
example_translation: 同學會上，妮娜抱著老室友說：『好久不見。』

definition: 教學時要求對方跟著複誦
example: The language teacher said, 'Repeat after me: the station is nearby.'
example_translation: 語言老師說：『跟著我念：車站就在附近。』

definition: 鼓勵心情低落的人振作
example: After Mia lost the match, her friend said, 'Cheer up—we can practice tomorrow.'
example_translation: 米雅輸掉比賽後，朋友說：『振作點，我們明天可以練習。』

definition: 提醒對方呼吸並稍微冷靜
example: Before opening the exam paper, the teacher said, 'Take a breath and read carefully.'
example_translation: 打開考卷前，老師說：『深呼吸，仔細閱讀。』

definition: 表示大家都準備專心聽對方說
example: When Priya announced a surprise, her family said, 'We are all ears.'
example_translation: 普莉雅說有驚喜要宣布時，家人說：『我們洗耳恭聽。』

definition: 引出令人意外但真實的消息
example: 'Believe it or not, this tiny café has served three presidents,' the guide said.
example_translation: 嚮導說：『信不信由你，這間小咖啡館接待過三位總統。』

definition: 提醒或要求對方不要違規
example: Before the field trip, the teacher warned, 'Don't break the rules at the museum.'
example_translation: 校外教學前，老師提醒：『在博物館不要違反規定。』

definition: 要求對方停止無禮的言行
example: When the customer insulted a waiter, his friend said, 'Stop being rude.'
example_translation: 顧客侮辱服務生時，他的朋友說：『別再這麼沒禮貌。』

definition: 要求對方忍住別說出某些話
example: During the tense meeting, Ana whispered to Ben, 'Hold your tongue for now.'
example_translation: 氣氛緊張的會議中，安娜低聲對班說：『現在先別說。』

definition: 為自己遲到向對方道歉
example: Rushing into the dental clinic, Leo said, 'I'm sorry I'm late; the bus broke down.'
example_translation: 里歐匆忙走進牙科診所說：『抱歉我遲到了，公車拋錨。』

definition: 真誠請求對方原諒自己
example: After forgetting their anniversary, Jon said, 'Forgive me; I will make it up to you.'
example_translation: 忘記紀念日後，喬恩說：『請原諒我，我會補償你。』

definition: 詢問對方之前去了哪裡
example: When Nina returned after midnight, her roommate asked, 'Where were you?'
example_translation: 妮娜半夜回來時，室友問：『你去哪裡了？』

definition: 表示自己睡過頭了
example: Arriving at rehearsal breathless, Kai said, 'I overslept and missed my train.'
example_translation: 凱氣喘吁吁抵達排練場，說：『我睡過頭，錯過火車了。』

definition: 稱讚嘗試，也可表示沒被騙到
example: When the child nearly scored, her coach smiled and said, 'Nice try.'
example_translation: 孩子差點得分時，教練笑著說：『嘗試得不錯。』

definition: 對不如意的消息表示遺憾
example: 'The outdoor concert was canceled.' 'That's too bad; I had tickets.'
example_translation: 『戶外音樂會取消了。』『真可惜，我已經有票了。』

definition: 鼓勵或要求對方做得更好
example: After reading the rushed essay, the teacher said, 'You can do better than this.'
example_translation: 老師看完草率的作文後說：『你可以做得更好。』

definition: 請對方手下留情或別太嚴格
example: Before his first chess game, Leo joked, 'Go easy on me—I'm a beginner.'
example_translation: 第一次下棋前，里歐開玩笑說：『手下留情，我是新手。』

definition: 表示要有收穫就得付出努力
example: During the last set, the trainer smiled and said, 'No pain no gain—keep pushing.'
example_translation: 最後一組訓練時，教練笑說：『一分耕耘一分收穫，繼續努力。』

definition: 勸人接受現況，不再干預
example: When the siblings argued over the crooked poster, Mom said, 'Let it be for tonight.'
example_translation: 手足為貼歪的海報爭論時，媽媽說：『今晚就先這樣吧。』

definition: （口語）無奈接受人生不如意
example: When rain spoiled our picnic, Dad shrugged and said, 'That's life.'
example_translation: 雨毀了野餐時，爸爸聳肩說：『人生就是這樣。』

definition: 表示結果要過一段時間才會明朗
example: Asked whether the new shop would succeed, Maya said, 'Time will tell.'
example_translation: 被問到新店會不會成功時，瑪雅說：『時間會證明一切。』

definition: 表示自己無法控制某種反應或情況
example: When the sad film made him cry, Ben said, 'I can't help it.'
example_translation: 悲傷電影讓班哭泣時，他說：『我就是忍不住。』

definition: （口語）鼓勵對方放手去做
example: When Ana considered applying for the scholarship, her teacher said, 'Go for it.'
example_translation: 安娜考慮申請獎學金時，老師說：『放手去做吧。』

definition: （簡短口語）表示輪到對方了
example: After rolling the dice, Dad passed them to Mia and said, 'Your turn.'
example_translation: 爸爸擲完骰子後交給米雅說：『輪到你了。』

definition: 詢問內容或做法是否正確
example: The student showed her calculation and asked, 'Is this correct?'
example_translation: 學生拿出算式問：『這樣正確嗎？』

definition: 表示當然同意或答案很明確
example: 'May I use your charger?' 'Of course—it's on the desk.'
example_translation: 『我可以用你的充電器嗎？』『當然，在桌上。』

definition: （口語）表示不完全正確
example: 'So the meeting is canceled?' 'Not exactly; it was moved online.'
example_translation: 『所以會議取消了？』『不完全是，改成線上舉行。』

definition: 表示成功做到或及時抵達
example: Reaching the gate before it closed, Nina laughed, 'I made it!'
example_translation: 妮娜在登機門關閉前趕到，笑道：『我趕上了！』

definition: 用來祝賀對方取得好結果
example: When Omar announced his promotion, everyone said, 'Congratulations!'
example_translation: 奧瑪宣布升職時，大家都說：『恭喜！』

definition: 提議大家一起自拍
example: At the mountain viewpoint, Lia raised her phone and said, 'Let's take a selfie.'
example_translation: 在山景觀景台，莉亞舉起手機說：『我們來自拍吧。』

definition: 要求把燈關掉
example: Before leaving the office, the manager reminded me, 'Turn off the lights.'
example_translation: 離開辦公室前，經理提醒我：『把燈關掉。』

definition: 提議彼此同行
example: When we learned we had the same appointment, Mia said, 'Let's go together.'
example_translation: 得知我們約在同一時間後，米雅說：『我們一起去吧。』

definition: 表示願意陪對方一起去
example: When Dad needed to visit the clinic, I said, 'I'll go with you.'
example_translation: 爸爸需要去診所時，我說：『我陪你一起去。』

definition: 初次見面時的禮貌問候
example: At the new office, Chen shook my hand and said, 'Nice to meet you.'
example_translation: 在新辦公室，陳與我握手說：『很高興認識你。』

definition: （口語）表示對方讓自己非常開心
example: When a child gave her a thank-you card, the nurse said, 'You made my day.'
example_translation: 孩子送給護理師一張感謝卡時，她說：『你讓我今天好開心。』

definition: 感謝對方特地前來
example: As the last guest left, the host smiled and said, 'Thanks for coming.'
example_translation: 最後一位客人離開時，主人笑說：『謝謝你來。』

definition: 提議今天工作到此為止
example: After packing the final order, the supervisor said, 'Let's call it a day.'
example_translation: 打包完最後一筆訂單後，主管說：『今天就做到這裡吧。』

definition: 回到家時告知家人自己到了
example: Opening the front door after work, Dad called, 'I'm home!'
example_translation: 爸爸下班打開前門時喊道：『我回來了！』

definition: 歡迎對方回來
example: When Ana returned from her trip, her coworkers said, 'Welcome back!'
example_translation: 安娜旅行歸來時，同事們說：『歡迎回來！』

definition: 道別時叮嚀對方保重
example: As Grandma boarded the train, we waved and called, 'Take care!'
example_translation: 奶奶登上火車時，我們揮手喊道：『保重！』

definition: 道別時希望日後保持聯絡
example: On our last day at camp, Zoe told her cabin mates, 'Keep in touch.'
example_translation: 營隊最後一天，柔伊對同房夥伴說：『要保持聯絡。』

definition: 熱情稱讚對方非常出色
example: When Ben fixed my bike for free, I laughed, 'You are the best!'
example_translation: 班免費修好我的腳踏車時，我笑說：『你最棒了！』

definition: 表示到了該上床睡覺的時間
example: After the bedtime story, Mom closed the book and said, 'Time for bed.'
example_translation: 睡前故事講完後，媽媽闔上書說：『該睡覺了。』

definition: 睡前祝對方做個好夢
example: Dad tucked in the children and whispered, 'Sweet dreams, both of you.'
example_translation: 爸爸替孩子們蓋好被子，低聲說：『你們倆做個好夢。』
